scripts.text:
[Jiwon]
I think we're really
fortunate to be able to
live in such a beautiful
and peaceful city like this.
scripts.translation:
[智元]
我觉得能生活在这样一个
美丽又和平的城市里，
我们真的很幸运。

scripts.text:
[Jiwon]
It's just so nice to
have this pleasant weather,
these lush gardens and to
meet all of these kind people.
Lighthalzen is like Asgard
in Midgard, heaven on earth~
scripts.translation:
[智元]
能拥有这么宜人的天气，
这么茂盛的花园，
还能遇到这么多善良的人，
感觉真是太好了。
里希塔乐镇简直就像是
米德加尔特的阿斯加德，
人间天堂啊~

scripts.text:
[Samnang]
^333333*Sigh...*^000000
It gets harder for me
to move around as I get
older. That's understandable
for an elderly person, right?
scripts.translation:
[萨姆南]
^333333*唉...*^000000
随着年纪变大，
我行动起来越来越吃力了。
对于一个老人来说，
这很正常吧？

scripts.text:
[Samnang]
Just the other day, these
hoodlums in black suits
were yelling at me to get out
of their way. But of course,
I didn't move quickly enough.
So what did they do to me?
scripts.translation:
[萨姆南]
就在前几天，那群穿黑西装的
无赖竟然冲我大喊大叫，
叫我快点让路。
但我当然没能动作够快。
于是他们对我做了什么呢？

scripts.text:
[Samnang]
They punched me.
Right in the womb!
I know that I'm not
pregnant, but that's
besides the point. Never hit
a lady, especially an old one!
scripts.translation:
[萨姆南]
他们揍了我。
直接揍在我的小腹上！
虽然我知道我没怀孕，
但那不是重点。
绝对不能动手打女士，
尤其是老太太！

scripts.text:
[Ruth]
Sweety, isn't it
nice to be together
under this beautiful
sunlight? It's perfect
for our date. Ahhhh~
scripts.translation:
[露丝]
甜心，在这么灿烂的阳光下
能在一起，是不是很棒？
这简直是约会的完美时刻。
啊啊啊~

scripts.text:
[Ruth]
I'm so happy to be
with you. I feel like
I'm just melting with
happiness. Oh, I love
you so much, Oyoung.
scripts.translation:
[露丝]
能和你在一起我好幸福。
我觉得自己都要
被幸福融化了。
噢，我好爱你，五荣。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Whoa...
This couple is
really headed for
Cloud 9, aren't they?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哇哦...
这对情侣
真是沉浸在
幸福的云端里了，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Oyoung]
Girl, you look like
you're comin' down with
the love bug. But there's
only one prescription for
this ailment, ooooh yeah...
scripts.translation:
[五荣]
女孩，你看上去像是
染上了爱的病毒呢。
不过这种病只有一种
处方药，哦耶...

scripts.text:
[Oyoung]
You need yo'self
your daily dose of
vitamin O-YOUNG.
And your lips look like
they got vitamin deficiency.
I better take care of that~
scripts.translation:
[五荣]
你需要每天补充
定量的“五荣维生素”。
而且你的嘴唇看起来
像是缺乏维生素一样。
我最好来照顾一下~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Sweet Sister!
I don't know what's
more mind boggling--
The fact that he used
that line or the fact that
it's actually working...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
亲爱的妹妹！
我不知道到底什么是更让人
难以置信的——
是他用了这种土味情话，
还是这招居然真的奏效了...

scripts.text:
[Kariya]
I think ''Lighthalzen'' is
supposed to mean ''crest of
light,'' though I hear that this
city was actually named after
somebody. Who knows for sure?
scripts.translation:
[苅谷]
我想“里希塔乐镇”的意思
应该是“光之顶峰”，
不过我听说这座城市其实
是以某人的名字命名的。
谁知道呢？

scripts.text:
[Kariya]
Still, it's a fitting
name for the wealthiest
and most luxurious city in
all the Schwarzwald Republic.
So how do you like this place?
scripts.translation:
[苅谷]
尽管如此，这还是个很贴切的
名字，毕竟它是整个
修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国中
最富有、最豪华的城市。
那么，你觉得这里怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Sung]
When I grow up, I want
to become such a great
person that they'll make
a statue of me, just like
those statues over there.
scripts.translation:
[成]
等我长大了，我要成为
一个非常伟大的人，
让人们像那边那些雕像一样，
也为我立一座雕像。

scripts.text:
[Sung]
Then people would be like,
''Hey yo. That statue. That
guy must have been great!''
Just thinking about that
makes me feel so good!
scripts.translation:
[成]
那样人们就会说：
“嘿，看那个雕像。那家伙
一定是个了不起的人！”
光是想想这件事，
我就觉得好开心！

scripts.text:
[Sung]
That's it. I'm gonna
grow up as soon as I can.
Ooh, and I better grow tall
and handsome so my statue
will be even more awesome.
Yeah. Yeah, good idea, Sung...
scripts.translation:
[成]
就是这样。我要尽快
长大成人。
噢，我最好还要长得高大帅气，
这样我的雕像才会更威风。
没错，没错，好主意，成...

scripts.text:
[Sameer]
There are too many
loving couples in this city.
Cuddling and kissing and
hugging and necking. It's...
It's utterly distasteful.
scripts.translation:
[萨米尔]
这座城市里有太多
恩爱的恋人了。
搂搂抱抱，亲亲吻吻，
又是拥抱又是热吻。这简直...
简直太令人反感了。

scripts.text:
[Sameer]
I can't believe the
indecency I see everyday
near my own home. Don't
they know better than to be
so affectionate in places
where the public can see them?!
scripts.translation:
[萨米尔]
我简直不敢相信，每天在
我家附近都能看到
这些不雅的行为。
难道他们不知道在公共场合
表现得这么亲昵很不合适吗？！

scripts.text:
[Sameer]
Fortunately for the
world, I'm a bulwark
of morality. In fact, I have
no need for a woman. All
I need are my ship models,
teen novels and dominoes.
scripts.translation:
[萨米尔]
对世界来说，我很庆幸
自己是道德的堡垒。
事实上，我根本不需要女人。
我只需要我的船模、
青少年小说和多米诺骨牌。

scripts.text:
[Sameer]
I'm a completely well
adjusted individual, which
is why the authorities should
listen to me when I tell them
to arrest couples for indecency!
Hand holding. Have they no shame?!
scripts.translation:
[萨米尔]
我是一个心理完全健康的人，
所以当我说应该逮捕那些
行为不雅的情侣时，
当局应该听我的！
竟然还牵手。他们难道没有羞耻心吗？！

scripts.text:
[Janice]
Oh no, I think I got
lost again. The roads
here are so confusing!
I've lived here for such
a long time and I still
can't find my way around...
scripts.translation:
[珍妮丝]
噢不，我想我又迷路了。
这里的道路真是太让人困惑了！
我在这里住了这么久，却还是找不到路……

scripts.text:
[Elmer Keays]
Walking side by side
with you like this reminds
me of the old days. Back
then, everyone was jealous
that I had such a beautiful
woman by my side. Heh heh~
scripts.translation:
[埃尔默·基斯]
像这样和你并肩走在一起，
让我想起了过去的日子。
那时候，大家都嫉妒我身边
有这么一位美丽的女性。嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[Elmer Keays]
You're still the most
precious sight to these
old eyes, my dear. I'm
really lucky to be with you.
scripts.translation:
[埃尔默·基斯]
亲爱的，你依然是我这双老眼里
最珍贵的风景。能和你在一起，
我真的很幸运。

scripts.text:
[Margie Keays]
Oh darling, the
weather is so nice
and pleasant today.
I'm really glad we
decided to go take
a walk together~
scripts.translation:
[玛吉·基斯]
噢亲爱的，今天的天气
真是如此晴朗宜人。
我真高兴我们决定
一起出来散步~

scripts.text:
[Maivi]
...

[Maivi]
Ah...
I just had the nicest
nap. This nice weather
never fails to relax me.
The air here is so clean,
not like that Einbroch~
scripts.translation:
[麦维]
啊...
我刚睡了个好觉。
这种好天气总能让我放松下来。
这里的空气非常清新，
不像艾音布罗克那样~

scripts.text:
[Maivi]
This clean, pristine
environment is all thanks
to the Rekenber Corporation.
It's incredible what they can
do with technology now, isn't
it? Ahhh, it's so peaceful~
scripts.translation:
[麦维]
这种洁净、原始的环境，
全都要归功于雷肯伯公司。
现在的科技所能达到的成就，
真是令人难以置信，不是吗？
啊，真是太宁静了~

scripts.text:
[Klaubis]
Excuse me, but are you
a tourist? Well, welcome
to Lighthalzen! This city
has everything we need,
but it can be a little too
quiet and uneventful here.
scripts.translation:
[克劳比斯]
打扰一下，请问你是
游客吗？那么，欢迎来到
里希塔乐镇！这座城市拥有
我们所需的一切，但这里有时会显得
过于安静且平淡无奇。

scripts.text: Have you lived in here long?
scripts.translation: 你在这里住很久了吗？

scripts.text: I agree.
scripts.translation: 我同意。

scripts.text: Have you heard about the serial killer?
scripts.translation: 你听说过那个连环杀手吗？

scripts.text:
[Klaubis]
Yes, our family has
lived in this city for a
long time, starting with
my great grandfather. Let's
see, my family's been here
for about two hundred years.
scripts.translation:
[克劳比斯]
是的，我们家族在这一座城市
已经生活了很久，从我的曾祖父
那一辈就开始了。让我想想，
我们家在这里大概已经住了两百年了。

scripts.text:
[Klaubis]
You'd be surprised how
many people stay in their
hometowns. Even if you do
leave, though, you can always
come back. It wouldn't be your hometown if you couldn't, right?
scripts.translation:
[克劳比斯]
你会惊讶于有多少人会一直
留在自己的家乡。不过，即使你离开了，
你也可以随时回来。如果不能回来，
那就不叫家乡了，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Klaubis]
Yes, the atmosphere
can get pretty listless
around here. But still,
there are plenty of nice
sights to enjoy here in
Lighthalzen, so look around~
scripts.translation:
[克劳比斯]
是的，这里的氛围确实会变得
有些沉闷。不过，里希塔乐镇
依然有很多美景值得欣赏，
所以到处看看吧~

scripts.text:
[Klaubis]
You mean the Serial
Axe Murderer? I thought
that was an old ghost story.
Hm. I think that lady inside
the Weapon Shop would
know more about that tale...
scripts.translation:
[克劳比斯]
你是说那个连环斧头杀手？
我以为那只是个古老的鬼故事。
嗯。我想武器店里的那位女士
应该对那个传说了解更多……

scripts.text:
[Sigmund Ting]
You know what I noticed?
The guards at the border
to the slum seem distracted
sometimes. I made use of one
of their less attentive moments
and basically jumped the fence!
scripts.translation:
[西格蒙德·丁]
你知道我发现了什么吗？
贫民窟边界的守卫有时看起来
心不在焉。我趁他们不留神的时候，
直接翻过围栏进去了！

scripts.text:
[Sigmund Ting]
But once I was in the 
slums, I was pretty bored.
There really isn't much to
do there. Which makes me
wonder... Why guard it?
scripts.translation:
[西格蒙德·丁]
但一旦进了贫民窟，我就觉得挺无聊的。
那里真的没什么可做的。
这让我不禁怀疑……为什么要守着那里？

scripts.text:
[Joyce]
I can sense your
longing look within
the depths of my heart,
beating faster and faster
with a feverish passion~
scripts.translation:
[乔伊斯]
我能感觉到你那渴望的目光，
在我的内心深处，
正随着狂热的激情
跳动得越来越快~

scripts.text:
[Dan Song]
Those eyes of yours...
So pure and so deep,
like glimmering pools
of light. So, so beautiful...
scripts.translation:
[丹·宋]
你的眼神……
如此纯净，如此深邃，
宛如闪烁着光芒的水潭。
如此，如此美丽……

scripts.text:
[Collins]
I really wish that my
son will be able to join
the Rekenber Corporation.
They certainly provide the
best jobs in Lighthalzen.
scripts.translation:
[柯林斯]
我真的很希望我的
儿子以后能加入
雷肯贝尔公司。
他们确实提供了
里希塔乐镇最好的工作。

scripts.text:
[Collins]
Although they're a large,
major corporation, it's
almost impossible to get
employed by them. How
do people get hired there
in the first place anyway?
scripts.translation:
[柯林斯]
虽然他们是一家规模宏大的
主要企业，但想要
进入那里工作几乎是不可能的。
话说回来，到底是怎么
被录用进去的呢？

scripts.text:
[Villagomez]
I just step out to get
a haircut and now I'm
lost. Boy oh boy, I hope
I don't keep my family
waiting. ^333333*Sigh...*^000000
scripts.translation:
[维拉戈梅斯]
我只是出门剪个头发，
结果现在迷路了。
天哪，我希望
不会让家人等太久。
^333333*唉...*^000000

scripts.text:
[Kemp]
Have you ever seen the
people who work in that big
corporation over there? I think
their employees are all a bit
off kilter for some reason.
scripts.translation:
[肯普]
你见过在那家大公司
工作的那些人吗？
我觉得他们的员工
不知为何都有点不太正常。

scripts.text:
[Kemp]
I haven't been there
myself, but something
strange is happening with
all the people who work there.
scripts.translation:
[肯普]
我自己还没去过那里，
但所有在那里工作的人
似乎都发生了一些
奇怪的事情。

scripts.text:
[Mauro]
The youth in this city
have no appreciation for
their elders. I've worked
so hard to help build this
city for so many years and
this is the thanks I get?
scripts.translation:
[毛罗]
这座城市的年轻人
根本不懂得尊重长辈。
我这么多年来一直
努力工作协助建设这座城市，
结果得到的报答就是这个吗？

scripts.text:
[Mauro]
Bah! If it weren't for
us, Lighthalzen wouldn't
be as prosperous as it is
today! Those kids don't
know that they owe their
lives of luxury to us...
scripts.translation:
[毛罗]
哼！要不是因为我们，
里希塔乐镇就不会像今天
这么繁荣了！那些孩子根本
不知道他们的奢侈生活
是靠我们换来的...

scripts.text:
[Sefith]
Good looks. Intelligence.
Excellent manners. A strong,
manly chin and overpowering,
piercing eyes. Perfectly balanced passion and charisma. All the
good things that ladies want.
scripts.translation:
[塞菲斯]
英俊的外貌，聪慧的头脑，
优雅的举止。坚毅的下颚和
锐利有力的眼神。激情与魅力
达到了完美的平衡。简直是
所有女性梦寐以求的一切。

scripts.text:
[Sefith]
But enough about me. Let's
discuss how sorry I should
feel for any other man living
in Lighthalzen. They don't hold
a candle to my studliness~
scripts.translation:
[塞菲斯]
不过别再说我了。我们来
讨论一下，对于住在里希塔乐镇
的其他男人，我应该感到多么
遗憾吧。他们根本无法与我的
雄风相比~

scripts.text:
[Jade]
I've heard that there's a
strange kingdom out there
that's basically ruled by
magic and swords, where
adventurers are enlisted
for the greater good.
scripts.translation:
[杰德]
我听说在外面有一个
奇特的王国，基本上是由
魔法和剑统治的，
冒险者们为了大义而
被征召前往。

scripts.text:
[Jade]
So are you from
Rune-Midgarts?
What do you think
of our city with its
advanced technology
and economy? Huh...
scripts.translation:
[杰德]
那么，你是从
卢恩·米德加兹来的吗？
你觉得我们这座拥有
先进技术和经济的
城市怎么样？嗯...

scripts.text:
[Jade]
Someday, I'd like
to go visit the land
where you came from.
It sounds so fantastic
and romantic in a way...
scripts.translation:
[杰德]
总有一天，我也想去
看看你来自的那片土地。
听起来既奇幻又
带有一种浪漫色彩...

scripts.text:
[Khramptd]
The land around here
is some pretty expensive
property. Yes, it's perfect
for building my awesome palace!
I don't have enough funds at the
moment, but the day will come~
scripts.translation:
[克拉姆普特]
这附近的土地可是
非常昂贵的地产。没错，
这里非常适合建造我那
宏伟的宫殿！虽然我现在
资金不足，但那一天终会到来~

scripts.text:
[Maggie]
Sure, I sell a lot
of flowers here, but
the lease that this city
makes me pay cuts into
my profits. It's almost not
worth renting this property.
scripts.translation:
[玛姬]
没错，我在这里卖很多
花，但这座城市向我
收取的租金削减了我的利润。
租下这里的地皮简直
快不划算了。

scripts.text:
[Maggie]
I pay such a ridiculous
amount for the lease and the
laws here won't let me raise
the price of my flowers. Why
are the city officials so greedy?
scripts.translation:
[玛姬]
我支付了如此高昂的
租金，这里的法律又不允许
我涨花价。为什么
市政官员们都这么贪婪？

scripts.text:
[Wallace]
......
That lady, working
for that one company,
Kafra, Mafra or whatever.
She certainly is very charming.
scripts.translation:
[华莱士]
......
那位女士，在某家公司
工作的，好像是卡普拉、
玛芙拉之类的。她确实
非常有魅力。

scripts.text:
[Wallace]
Now, if I were
thirty years younger...
Wait! I'm a rich and powerful
man. I could ask her out now.
Hm? What's that look for?
scripts.translation:
[华莱士]
要是能再年轻三十岁的话...
等等！我可是个富有且有权势的
男人。我现在就可以约她出去。
嗯？你那是什么眼神？

scripts.text:
[Lucius]
Hello youngster~
Would you like to
make a donation
to help the hungry?
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯]
你好呀，年轻人~
你想捐款来
帮助饥饿的人吗？

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 好的。

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Lucius]
Now, you can donate 1 to
30,000 zeny that will be used
to support the poor and feed
starving children. If you wish
to cancel, please enter ''0.''
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯]
你可以捐赠 1 到
30,000 泽尼，这些钱将用于
救济穷人和喂饱
饥饿的孩子。如果你想
取消，请输入 ''0''。

scripts.text:
[Lucius]
Please enter a value
from 1 to 30,000 in
order to make a donation
to the needy, youngster.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯]
年轻人，请输入
1 到 30,000 之间的
金额，为贫困者
进行捐款。

scripts.text:
[Lucius]
How disappointing,
but I'm sure you have
your reasons. Well, when
you can afford to give to
the needy, you're welcome
to come back at any time.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯]
真令人失望，
但我相信你一定有
你的理由。好吧，当你
以后有能力资助贫困者时，
随时欢迎回来。

scripts.text:
[Lucius]
Thank you so much
for your {0} zeny donation.
I promise that your money
will be put to good use in
benefiting the poor and needy.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯]
非常感谢你
捐赠的 {0} 泽尼。
我保证你的钱
一定会用于改善
贫困者的生活。

scripts.text:
[Lucius]
Still, I'm just a little
disappointed. An adventurer
like you should be donating
as much as you possibly can...
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯]
不过，我还是觉得
有点小小的失望。
像你这样的冒险者，
应该尽可能多地捐款才对……

scripts.text:
[Lucius]
So far, I've received
a total of {0} zeny in
donations. I'm glad to see
that there are still kind and
generous people in the world.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯]
到目前为止，
我一共收到了 {0} 泽尼
的捐款。很高兴看到
这世界上依然有如此
善良且慷慨的人。

scripts.text:
[Lucius]
This should be enough
to send to the Poor Relief
Organization. Please accept
this small gift as a token of
my gratitude, adventurer. Bless
you, youngster and take care.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯]
这些应该足够
交给救济组织了。请收下
这份小礼物，作为我对
冒险者的谢意。愿你
平安，年轻人，保重。

scripts.text:
[Lucius]
I understand. Still,
keep in mind that when
you give from your heart,
you will be rewarded tenfold.
Though I admit, the benefits
aren't always readily apparent.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯]
我明白了。不过，
请记住，当你全心全意
去给予时，你会得到
十倍的回报。虽然我承认，
这些回报并不总是显而易见的。

scripts.text:
[Lucius]
Hello youngster~
You seem to be fairly
well-off. Money is good
to have, but be careful not
to become obsessed with it.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯]
你好，年轻人~
你看起来相当
富有。拥有金钱是好事，
但要小心不要被它
所迷惑。

scripts.text:
[Lucius]
When you have the chance,
please show your generosity
towards others who may be
much less fortunate than you.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯]
当你有机会的时候，
请向那些境遇比你
差得多的弱势群体
展示你的慷慨。

scripts.text:
[Laqumet]
Sure, manliness is quite
attractive, but I think women
appreciate a guy who could
sympathize and talk with them
a little more. Don't you agree?
scripts.translation:
[拉库梅特]
当然，男子气概确实
很有吸引力，但我认为
女性更欣赏那些能够
体贴并能与她们
多聊聊天的男人。你觉得呢？

scripts.text:
[Laqumet]
I might not be like Sefith,
but I guess I've got a cute
smile, a good personality and
I'm a dandy to boot. Hopefully,
my honesty and loyalty will
help me find someone good.
scripts.translation:
[拉库梅特]
我可能不像塞菲斯那样，
但我猜我的笑容很可爱，
性格也很好，而且还是个
帅哥。希望我的诚实和忠诚
能帮我找到一个好对象。

scripts.text:
[Hotel Employee]
If you are experiencing
any sort of inconvenience,
please do not hesitate and
let us know right away.
scripts.translation:
[酒店员工]
如果您遇到任何
不便之处，
请务必立即
告知我们。

scripts.text:
[Hotel Employee]
Please use the stairs
at the northern end to
go downstairs so that you
can go to the Front Desk.
Thank you and I hope that
you enjoy your stay here.
scripts.translation:
[酒店员工]
请使用北侧的
楼梯下楼，
即可到达前台。
谢谢，希望您
在这里住得愉快。

scripts.text:
[Christopher Michael]
OoooOoh~
Soooo comfortable.
Don't want to wake up.
Don't want to get up.
Ever again. OoOoooh...
scripts.translation:
[克里斯托弗·迈克尔]
唔唔唔~
好舒服啊。
不想醒来。
不想起床。
再也不想起来了。唔唔唔……

scripts.text:
[Safwat Fahmy]
This hotel is nice
and comfortable, but
to be quite frank, the
drinks here are horrible.
They're unfit for drinking
men such as myself.
scripts.translation:
[萨夫瓦特·法赫米]
这家酒店很漂亮
也很舒适，但
坦白说，这里的
饮料简直难喝透了。
根本不适合像我这样的
男人饮用。

scripts.text:
[Safwat Fahmy]
If this is the best hotel,
I expect them to provide me
with the best alcohol. When
I stay at a hotel, that's what
I want. To spend the entire
day not being sober.
scripts.translation:
[萨夫瓦特·法赫米]
如果这是最好的酒店，
我希望他们能提供
最好的酒。当我住进酒店时，
我想要的就是这个：
整天都沉浸在微醺之中。

scripts.text:
[Safwat Fahmy]
It looks like that
today I'll be heading
out to the bar again...
I just wish there were
someplace quieter to drink.
scripts.translation:
[萨夫瓦特·法赫米]
看来今天我又要
去酒吧了……
我只希望有个更安静的
地方可以喝酒。

scripts.text:
[Hotel Employee]
This is the Couple Suite.
A single can also check
in here, but our hotel will
prioritize couples when
assigning this room.
scripts.translation:
[酒店员工]
这是双人套房。
单人也可以入住，
但我们酒店在分配
此类房间时会优先考虑
情侣。

scripts.text:
[Tanoue]
This chair looks
very nice, but it really
chills my bottom. Brr...!
It's a might uncomfortable!
scripts.translation:
[田上]
这把椅子看起来
很不错，但坐着真的很
冰凉。呜……！
感觉有点不舒服！

scripts.text:
[Tanoue]
You know what the
perfect chair would
be like? It would be
plush and have electronic
massage and heating controls...
scripts.translation:
[田上]
你知道什么样的
椅子才是完美的吗？
应该是那种柔软舒适，
还带有电子按摩和
加热功能的……

scripts.text:
[Ben Allen]
Aaahhh Oooooh~
It's sooooo comfy~
The air's so fresh and
this couch is so plush...
Why can't home be like this?
scripts.translation:
[本·艾伦]
啊啊啊啊~
好舒服啊~
空气好清新，
这沙发也太软了...
为什么家里不能像这样呢？

scripts.text:
[Ben Allen]
I've been in those other
hotels and let me tell you,
this place is the best ever.
After a night's sleep over
here, I feel like a new man!
scripts.translation:
[本·艾伦]
我住过其他的酒店，
我跟你说，
这里绝对是最棒的。
在这里睡上一觉，
我觉得自己焕然一新！

scripts.text:
[Harp]
Oh sweet jiminy...
That Kafra Lady is so hot.
What a body. And those glasses.
I just gotta ask her out somehow.
scripts.translation:
[竖琴]
噢，天哪...
那位卡普拉女士好火辣。
身材真好，还有那副眼镜。
我一定要想办法约她出来。

scripts.text:
[Harp]
Hm, but what should
I do? A love letter? Naw,
that's kind of outdated.
Argh, I can't think! Just
looking at her makes me feel
so happy! Praise be to Kafra!
scripts.translation:
[竖琴]
唔，但我该
怎么办呢？写情书？不，
那有点过时了。
啊，我没法思考了！只要
看着她，我就觉得
好幸福！赞美卡普拉！

scripts.text:
[Hotel Employee]
''Hospitality with a smile
and total devotion to your
comfort.'' That's our motto
in the Royal Dragon Hotel.
Please inquire at the front
desk if you wish to check in.
scripts.translation:
[酒店员工]
“微笑服务，
全心全意为您提供舒适体验。”
这是皇家龙酒店的座右铭。
如果您想办理入住，
请前往前台咨询。

scripts.text:
[Hotel Employee]
Welcome to the
Royal Dragon Hotel Bar.
How about a nice night
cap before going to bed?
scripts.translation:
[酒店员工]
欢迎光临
皇家龙酒店酒吧。
在睡觉之前，
要不要来一杯美酒呢？

scripts.text:
[Hotel Employee]
If you're looking
for a friend, you
can almost always
make one in this bar.
Alcohol certainly is the
grease for social gears.
scripts.translation:
[酒店员工]
如果您在寻找
朋友，在这间酒吧里
几乎总能交到新朋友。
酒精确实是
社交的润滑剂。

scripts.text:
[Hachi]
Oh yeah. I love-love-love
bars. If I don't come here
for the booze, then I'm here
for all these beautiful ladies.
scripts.translation:
[八]
噢耶。我最、最、最喜欢
酒吧了。如果不是为了
喝酒，那我就是为了
这些美女们而来的。

scripts.text:
[Hachi]
Weird. It's the very first
time I've tried this place's
rum, but doesn't it taste like
pure sexiness to you? Huh...
Oh well, back to schmoozin'
with all the hot chicks~
scripts.translation:
[八]
奇怪。这还是我第一次
尝试这里的朗姆酒，
但你不觉得它尝起来
充满了诱惑力吗？唔...
算了，还是回去跟
那些辣妹们搭讪吧~

scripts.text:
[Duff]
Hey, you're from
Rune-Midgarts, right?
Please make yourself
at home while you're here
in Lighthalzen and have
yourself a good time.
scripts.translation:
[达夫]
嘿，你是从
卢恩·米德加兹来的吧？
在里希塔乐镇期间，
请尽情放松，
玩得开心点。

scripts.text:
[Rona]
I hate it when guys
just sidle up and sort
of just skip Steps One
and Two. And before you
get all weird, Step Three
is ''Ask for my phone number.''
scripts.translation:
[罗娜]
我讨厌那些男生
直接凑过来，
完全跳过第一步
和第二步的行为。在你们
变得奇怪之前，第三步
可是“要我的电话号码”。

scripts.text:
[Rona]
I would just really
appreciate it if one
nice boy would just
talk to me for real.
scripts.translation:
[罗娜]
如果有一个
好男孩能真正地
跟我好好聊聊天，
我会非常感激的。

scripts.text:
[Greenfield]
I don't believe it...
This unlucky streak
will never end, will it?
I lost all my Apples
playing Dice today.
Again. Oh man...
scripts.translation:
[格林菲尔德]
不敢相信...
这倒霉的运气
永远不会结束吗？
今天玩骰子的时候
把我的苹果全赔光了。
又来了。噢天哪...

scripts.text:
[Greenfield]
Okay. Okay.
If I just keep
playing, eventually
I'll win. I mean, that's
the way the odds work, right?
Even when they're against me...
scripts.translation:
[格林菲尔德]
好吧。好吧。
只要我一直
玩下去，迟早会赢的。
我的意思是，概率
就是这么回事，对吧？
即使胜算对我并不利...

scripts.text:
[Terry]
I'm not big on drinking,
but the atmosphere in this
place is really nice. The
music they play is always
smooth and relaxing...
scripts.translation:
[特里]
我不怎么爱喝酒，
但这里的氛围真的很棒。
播放的音乐总是
那么平缓舒缓...

scripts.text:
[Terry]
Yeah, this is a real cozy
joint. I recommend it to
all you tourists, actually.
Now why don't you kick
back and chill with me?
scripts.translation:
[特里]
是啊，这里真是个
温馨的地方。其实我
向所有游客推荐这里。
现在，你为什么不
坐下来和我一起放松一下呢？

scripts.text:
[Sei]
You see that guy?
That guy over there is
always looking at me.
I wonder... Does he want
to ask me out or something?
scripts.translation:
[圣]
你看到那个家伙了吗？
那边那个家伙
一直在盯着我看。
我在想... 他是不是想
约我出去什么的？

scripts.text:
[Sei]
Well, if he does,
shouldn't he have
more guts? Or are 
you boys much more
shy than I think you are?
scripts.translation:
[圣]
好吧，如果他真想约我，
难道不应该
更有胆量一点吗？还是说
你们男生其实比我想象的
要害羞得多？

scripts.text:
[Sei]
Well, he is sort of
cute. Geez, this would
be so much easier if he
would just come up and
start talking to me...
scripts.translation:
[圣]
好吧，他确实还挺
可爱的。天呐，如果他
能直接走过来跟我
搭话，事情就会
简单得多...

scripts.text:
[Merpi]
Isn't the weather nice
today? All this sunlight
will dry these clothes
quickly and give them
a fresh, lovely scent.
scripts.translation:
[梅尔皮]
今天天气真好呀。
这些阳光能让衣服
很快干透，并散发出
清新宜人的香气。

scripts.text:
[Merpi]
Oh, an adventurer from
Rune-Midgarts, are you?
How do you like our city?
If you have any questions,
feel free to ask me anything.
scripts.translation:
[梅尔皮]
哦，你是来自
卢恩·米德加兹的冒险者吗？
觉得我们的城市怎么样？
如果你有什么问题，
尽管来问我吧。

scripts.text: Well, I have nothing to ask...
scripts.translation: 嗯，我没什么好问的...

scripts.text: Any news or rumors?
scripts.translation: 有什么新闻或传闻吗？

scripts.text: I like laundry too.
scripts.translation: 我也很喜欢洗衣服。

scripts.text:
[Merpi]
Oh, really?
Well, if you've traveled
all over the world, maybe
you've found a place just
like Lighthalzen, so maybe
you're already comfortable?
scripts.translation:
[梅尔皮]
噢，真的吗？
既然你已经走遍了
世界各地，也许你见过
和里希塔乐镇很像的地方，
所以已经习惯这里了吧？

scripts.text:
[Merpi]
Well, things have
been pretty peaceful
for the past few years.
The only rumor floating
around is about some
weird axe murderer...
scripts.translation:
[梅尔皮]
嗯，过去这几年里，
一切都还算太平。
唯一的传闻就是关于
某个奇怪的斧头杀人犯...

scripts.text:
[Merpi]
Oh, that's wonderful!
I so love doing hand
laundry, though I'm not
quite sure why. Oh well~
scripts.translation:
[梅尔皮]
噢，那太棒了！
我非常喜欢手洗衣服，
虽然我也说不上来
为什么。哎呀，算了~

scripts.text:
[Berru]
Daddy...! Waaaaah~!
I wanna see my Daddy!
scripts.translation:
[贝鲁]
爸爸...! 呜哇啊啊~！
我想见我的爸爸！

scripts.text:
[Pilia]
Berru, I don't 
think Daddy's coming
home tonight. Come on,
we should go to bed.
scripts.translation:
[皮莉娅]
贝鲁，我觉得
爸爸今晚不会回家了。
快点，我们该去睡觉了。

scripts.text:
[Berru]
No, I'm not gonna
sleep till Daddy gets
home! He said he'll
bring us candy tonight!
You go sleep first, Pilia!
scripts.translation:
[贝鲁]
不，在爸爸回家之前
我都不睡觉！他说他今晚
会带糖果回来的！
皮莉娅，你先去睡吧！

scripts.text:
[Pilia]
^333333*Sigh...*^000000
Where's our Daddy?
He said he found a
good job, but we haven't
heard from him since then...
scripts.translation:
[皮莉娅]
^333333*唉...*^000000
我们的爸爸在哪里？
他说他找到了一份
好工作，但从那以后
我们就再也没他的消息了...

scripts.text:
[Pilia]
What's taking him
so long? I hope Daddy
comes back home soon.
Come on, Berru, don't cry.
scripts.translation:
[皮莉娅]
他怎么要花这么长时间？
我希望爸爸能快点回家。
快点，贝鲁，别哭了。

scripts.text:
[Berru]
^333333*Sob...*^000000
But I'm hungry
and I miss Daddy!

[Pilia]
Uncle Togii from
next door hasn't
come back either...
scripts.translation:
[皮莉娅]
隔壁的托吉叔叔
也一直没有回来...

scripts.text:
[Pilia]
Hmm? Oh, I'm sorry,
but my little brother
just won't stop crying.
I'm sorry if we're loud...
scripts.translation:
[皮莉娅]
嗯？噢，很抱歉，
我弟弟一直哭个不停。
如果吵到你们了，真是不好意思...

scripts.text:
[Pilia]
Our daddy goes to work
somewhere far away. He
finally has a good job, but
sometimes we don't hear
from him for days. We get
really worried about him.
scripts.translation:
[皮莉娅]
我们的爸爸去很远的地方工作。
他终于找到了一份好工作，
但有时我们会好几天
都收不到他的消息。我们
真的很担心他。

scripts.text:
[Pilia]
My brother Berru always
misses him a lot. I don't
know how to make him
stop crying! What do I do?
scripts.translation:
[皮莉娅]
我的弟弟贝鲁总是
非常想念他。我不知道
该怎么让他停止哭泣！
我该怎么办？

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
Please...
My child is starving...
Would you give me
some money?
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
求求你了...
我的孩子快饿死了...
能不能请你
给我一点钱？

scripts.text: Give him some money.
scripts.translation: 给他一些钱

scripts.text: Ignore him.
scripts.translation: 无视他

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
I appreciate your
kindness, but it also
looks like you're in need
of zeny, too. Would you
like to join me?
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
我很感激你的善意，但看起来你似乎也需要泽尼。你想加入我吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Here you go,
take this.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
给你，拿着这个吧。

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
Thank you so much.
I have nothing to offer you
in exchange, but I can share
a story with you and impart
some of the wisdom I've
learned over the years.
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
非常感谢。我没有什么可以回报你的，但我可以和你分享一个故事，并传授一些我多年来积累的智慧。

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
Everyone's been in
a situation where you
sometimes you feel that
you have to make a choice
between doing the right thing
and doing what you want, right?
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
每个人都会遇到这样的情况：有时候你会觉得，你必须在做正确的事和做你想做的事之间做出选择，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
You may feel trapped.
Well, let me tell you, when
it comes to a problem, all
the solutions available to
you aren't always obvious.
So just calm down and think.
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
你可能会感到被困住了。好吧，让我告诉你，当面对问题时，所有可行的解决方案并不总是显而易见的。所以，请冷静下来思考。

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
What you can see and
understand might not match
with reality. Like the stars that are always there, but not visible
during the day, we'll always have hope, even if we can't see it.
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
你所能看到和理解的，可能与现实并不相符。就像那些一直存在但白天看不见的星星一样，即使我们看不见希望，希望也永远存在。

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
Hmm...?
You seem surprised~
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
嗯...？
你看起来很惊讶呢~

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
I sort of believe in fate and
sort of don't. Let me explain
it this way. I take life day by
day, with each day covering its
own spectrum with miracle on one end and tragedy on the other.
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
我半信半疑地相信命运。让我这样解释吧：我过着一日三餐的生活，每一天都有它自己的光谱，一端是奇迹，另一端是悲剧。

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
So each day has the capacity
for experiences that can be
good, bad or both. I believe
each person can take an 
active role in shaping their
destiny, day by day.
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
所以每一天都有可能发生好事、坏事，或者两者兼有。我相信每个人都可以通过每一天的努力，在塑造自己的命运中发挥积极作用。

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
Now, there may be certain
things that you can't control,
but even a pessimist might
be able to agree that this
is a world that not only has
tragedy, but miracles as well.
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
现在，也许有些事情是你无法控制的，但即使是悲观主义者也可能会同意，这个世界不仅有悲剧，也有奇迹。

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
Stand up when you're down
and live your life with passion. The capacity for miracles will
always be there and know that
you can be someone else's
miracle. Isn't that wonderful?
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
跌倒了就站起来，充满激情地生活吧。奇迹的机会永远都在，而且要知道，你也可以成为别人的奇迹。这难道不美好吗？

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
Don't believe me?
Well, you'll see for
yourself, youngster.
There's much good in you.
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
不相信我吗？
好吧，你会亲眼见证的，年轻人。你身上有很多闪光点。

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
Anger. People deal with
it in different ways. Some
suppress it. Some relish it.
Some fear being angry. Now,
to be simple, let's say there
are two kinds of anger.
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
愤怒。人们处理愤怒的方式各不相同。有些人压抑它，有些人沉溺其中，有些人则害怕愤怒。现在，简单来说，愤怒可以分为两种。

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
The first is the kind that
isn't so productive. More of
a frustration that you can let
go. Someone cut you off on the
freeway or a friend innocently forgot your birthday? No biggie.
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
第一种是没什么建设性的愤怒。更多的是一种可以释怀的挫败感。比如有人在公路上加塞，或者朋友无心地忘了你的生日？没什么大不了的。

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
Don't let this kind of
anger get to you or you'll
look like a loser. Think of
the big picture and if you're
still upset, vent appropriately. Be honest without hurting anyone.
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
不要让这种愤怒影响到你，否则你会显得很窝囊。要从大局出发，如果你仍然感到不快，就适当地发泄出来。在不伤害任何人的情况下保持诚实。

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
The second kind of anger
is righteous anger. You've
been wronged and need 
some form of retribution. 
Just don't misdirect your anger
and respond appropriately.
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
第二种愤怒是正义之怒。你受到了委屈，需要某种形式的正义。只要不要发泄错对象，并做出适当的回应即可。

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
The second kind of anger is
righteous anger. You've been
wronged and need some form
of retribution. Remember to
make appropriate confrontations
and don't misdirect your rage.
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
第二种愤怒是正义之怒。你受到了委屈，需要某种形式的正义。记住要进行适当的对抗，不要把怒火发错对象。

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
Getting into a fight with
righteous anger, say to protect
someone dear to you, will make
you a hero. Fighting with anger
born of frustration will make you a bully. Know the difference.
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
带着正义的愤怒去战斗，
为了守护你珍视的人，
你会成为英雄。但若带着
挫败感而生的愤怒去战斗，
你只会成为一个恶霸。
要分清这两者的区别。

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
What's wrong?
It might be a lot
to take in, I know.
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
怎么了？
我知道，这可能让你
有些难以接受。

scripts.text:
[Reuben]
Someday...
Someday I just gotta
become a train conductor
and just get outta here!
I really hate this place!
scripts.translation:
[鲁本]
总有一天...
总有一天我一定要
成为一名列车长，
然后离开这个鬼地方！
我真的讨厌这里！

scripts.output:
[鲁本]
哇——！
你刚才是不是听到
我在自言自语了？
糟了！别这么爱管闲事！
scripts.text:
[Reuben]]
Wh-whoa...!
Did you just hear
me talk to myself?
Crud! Don't be so nosy!

[Reuben]
Hey. What are
you doing just
looking at me?
I don't know you
from Adam, so get lost~
scripts.translation:
[鲁本]
喂。你盯着我
看干什么？
我压根不认识你，
快走开啦~

scripts.text:
[Shengwen]
Am I just getting
paranoid? I really
think that some of
the people I know
are disappearing
for no good reason!
scripts.translation:
[圣文]
是我变得疑神疑鬼了吗？
我真的觉得，我认识的
有些人正在无缘无故地
消失！

scripts.text:
[Shengwen]
I mean, all of my close
friends are all alright,
but I'm starting not to see
certain acquaintances and
familiar faces. Maybe I'm
just thinking too much...
scripts.translation:
[圣文]
我的意思是，虽然我的
亲密朋友们都还好，
但我开始发现有些熟人
和面孔都不见了。也许
只是我想太多了...

scripts.text:
[Shayna]
^333333*Sigh...*^000000
Oh, you poor
darling girl...

[Cenku Dekdam]
Man, if you were
gonna take this whole
city and then sell it, what
do you think Lighthalzen's
price tag would be, eh?
scripts.translation:
[岑库·德克丹]
伙计，如果你要把
整个城市都买下来
然后卖掉，你觉得
里希塔乐镇的标价
会是多少，嗯？

scripts.text:
[Cenku Dekdam]
I mean, this city
is basically just made
of money. Money is what
makes this city such a nice
and pleasant place to live.
scripts.translation:
[岑库·德克丹]
我是说，这座城市
基本上就是由金钱
构成的。正是金钱
让这座城市成为了一个
如此美好宜居的地方。

scripts.text:
[Angela]
Greetings, adventurer.
I'm Angela, a social
worker for the Poor
Relief Organization.
scripts.translation:
[安吉拉]
你好，冒险者。
我是安吉拉，是贫困
救济组织的社工。

scripts.text:
[Angela]
I've noticed that the
people living here have
extremely bad health and
it's not just because of
their circumstances.
scripts.translation:
[安吉拉]
我注意到居住在这里的
人们健康状况非常糟糕，
而且这不仅仅是因为
他们的生活环境所致。

scripts.text:
[Angela]
I've filed a report
to my superiors, but
they haven't sent me
a response yet for some
reason. I'm starting to get
a little worried about this...
scripts.translation:
[安吉拉]
我已经向我的上级
提交了报告，但出于
某种原因，他们还没有
给我任何回复。我开始
为此感到有些担心了...

scripts.text:
[Bankri Kun]
Must work...
Must focus...
Resist sleepiness...
Why do I keep coming
here? Ugh, h-horrible.
scripts.translation:
[班克里·昆]
必须工作...
必须集中注意力...
抵抗困意...
为什么我一直来到
这里？呃，太糟糕了。

scripts.text:
[Bankri Kun]
Hey youngster. You wanted
adventuring advice? Okay.
Um. Hm. Always. Brush.
Your teeth. Brush them
everyday. Oh, and don't
forget to floss, either.
scripts.translation:
[班克里·昆]
嘿，年轻人。你想听
冒险建议？好吧。
嗯。唔。一定要。
刷牙。每天都要
刷牙。噢，还有别忘了
用牙线。

scripts.text:
[Bankri Kun]
Now it's time for me
to head back to work.
I'll see you later, kid.
Sorry my advice was so
lame-- I couldn't think of
anything else to tell you.
scripts.translation:
[班克里·昆]
现在是我该回去
工作的时间了。
回头见，孩子。
抱歉我的建议这么
烂——我实在想不出
别的能告诉你的了。

scripts.text:
[Enoz]
So, the novel I ordered from
the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom
just recently arrived. It's real good, by the guy who wrote
''Roda Frog Adventure''
years ago. Remember?
scripts.translation:
[埃诺兹]
对了，我从卢恩·米德加兹
王国订购的小说
最近刚到。非常棒，是多年前
写过《罗达蛙大冒险》的
那个家伙写的。还记得吗？

scripts.text:
[Enoz]
Anyway, this new book,
''Where the Red Plant Grows''
is up for the Yggdrasilberry
Award. I... I don't know why
I was compelled to share that
with you. Seriously, I don't...
scripts.translation:
[埃诺兹]
总之，这本新书
《红草生长之地》
正在角逐世界树果实奖。
我...我也不知道为什么
非要跟你分享这件事。
说真的，我也不知道...

scripts.text:
[Ellette]
...

[{0}]
Excuse me.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
打扰一下。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello?

[Ellette]
...Oh! Everyone!
I just completed
another one! Hooray!
scripts.translation:
[艾莱特]
...啊！大家！
我又完成了一项任务！万岁！

scripts.text:
[All other Employees]
Wh-what?!
No way, not again!
scripts.translation:
[其他所有员工]
什、什么？！
不会吧，又来一次！

scripts.text:
[Leekal]
Are you even human?
You must have some
secret for that much
productivity. It's weird...
scripts.translation:
[利卡尔]
你到底是不是人类？
你肯定有什么提高效率的
秘密方法。真奇怪……

scripts.text:
[Ellette]
Oh, come on.
Maybe I'm a little
good at this, but there's
no way I can beat Cenku.
scripts.translation:
[艾莱特]
哎呀，别这样。
也许我确实有点擅长这个，
但我绝对不可能赢过Cenku的。

scripts.text:
[Dowbow Ryuei]
Just out of, oh I dunno,
curiosity, which word do
you like better? ''Uber-Cool''
or ''Reality?'' Pick one~
scripts.translation:
[道宝 龙英]
只是出于，呃，我也不知道，
好奇心，你更喜欢哪个词？
“超级酷”还是“现实”？选一个吧~

scripts.text: Uber-Cool
scripts.translation: 超级酷

scripts.text: Reality
scripts.translation: 现实

scripts.text:
[Dowbow Ryuei]
Oh yeah? Me too!
Yeah, we got the same
outlook on life. If you don't
mind, I'd like to shake
your hand, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[道宝 龙英]
哦是吗？我也是！
没错，我们的生活观是一致的。
如果不介意的话，冒险者，
我想和你握个手。

scripts.text:
[Dowbow Ryuei]
Reality, eh?
Well, I agree that
being realistic has its
perks, I'm more of a dreamer.
scripts.translation:
[道宝 龙英]
现实，是吗？
嗯，我同意保持现实确实有它的
好处，但我更像是一个梦想家。

scripts.text:
[Leekal]
So... Very broke.
Why did I spend so much
money on wine, women and
song? I regret it all, all the
pleasure I've had this month.
Yes, it was too much pleasure.
scripts.translation:
[利卡尔]
所以……穷得叮当响。
我为什么要花那么多钱在美酒、
美女和歌舞上？我后悔了，
这个月所有的享乐。是的，享乐过度了。

scripts.text:
[Ninjose]
That's what happens
when you're irresponsible
with your money. You really
should read this ''Anybody
Can Be Rich'' book.
scripts.translation:
[宁霍塞]
这就是你对金钱不负责任的
后果。你真的应该读读这本
《人人都能变富有》。

scripts.text:
[Ninjose]
At long last, I've finally
bought my own home. You
should invest your money for
your future too! Read this,
''Anybody Can Be Rich!''
It's such a great book!
scripts.translation:
[宁霍塞]
终于，我终于买了自己的房子。
你也应该为未来投资！
读读这本《人人都能变富有！》，
它是一本非常棒的书！

scripts.text:
[Kejulle Rekenber]
Hm? Sure, my last name
is Rekenber and that's the
same name as our chairman,
but that's just a coincidence.
I'm merely a normal employee.
Yeah, no special treatment...
scripts.translation:
[凯朱勒·雷肯贝尔]
嗯？当然，我的姓氏是
雷肯贝尔，和我们的董事长
同姓，但这只是巧合。
我只是个普通的员工。
没错，没有任何特殊待遇……

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis man here
is motionless,
and for all intents
and purposes, is
soundly asleep.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这个男人
一动不动，
从各方面来看，
他都睡得很熟。^000000

scripts.text:
[Joshua]
What am I doing here?
Waiting for my dream
woman to fall into my lap,
what else does it look like?
scripts.translation:
[约书亚]
我在这里干什么？
等着梦中情人主动投怀送抱，
还能是什么呢？

scripts.text:
[Joshua]
Tall, blond, creamy
complexion and smooth
skin. That's right. Come
right to Joshua, babes.
I got my pheromone spray
on and I'm ready to cruise~
scripts.translation:
[约书亚]
高挑、金发、肤白貌美、
皮肤光滑。没错。
宝贝们，快来找约书亚吧。
我喷了费洛蒙喷雾，
准备好去邂逅了~

scripts.text:
[Grinnel]
You know the men in
black suits? Boy, did
I get a scare! They actually
tracked me down to ask me
all these weird questions!
scripts.translation:
[格林内尔]
你知道那些穿黑西装的人吗？
天哪，吓死我了！
他们居然追踪到我，
问我这么多奇怪的问题！

scripts.text:
[Grinnel]
They kept wanting to
know if I had ever met
anyone from the Rekenber
Corporation, if I've ever been
Uptown, that sort of thing. They
really scared the crap out of me.
scripts.translation:
[格林内尔]
他们一直想知道我有没有见过
雷肯伯公司的人，有没有去过
上城区之类的。他们真的把我
吓坏了。

scripts.text:
[Grinnel]
Man, living in the
slums is such a drag.
Not only is life rough,
but all sorts of people
think they can push you
around. I hate Lighthalzen...
scripts.translation:
[格林内尔]
唉，住在贫民窟真是种折磨。
不仅生活艰辛，各种各样的人
还觉得可以随心所欲地欺负你。
我讨厌里希塔乐镇……

scripts.text:
[Haggar]
Whiskey!
I need me some
hard liquor now!
scripts.translation:
[哈加尔]
威士忌！
我现在就要喝烈酒！

scripts.text:
[Haggar]
Wha--? I didn't
order this stinkin'
rum! I want a man's
drink! Gimme whiskey!
scripts.translation:
[哈加尔]
啥——？我没点这种臭烘烘的
朗姆酒！我要喝男人的酒！
给我威士忌！

scripts.text:
[Tony]
Hey man, I know this
joint is a dive, pretty much
on the verge of bein' totally
ghetto, but we're proud to
have the best rum in all of
Midgard. It's true~
scripts.translation:
[托尼]
嘿伙计，我知道这地方很破，
简直快变成贫民窟了，但我们很
自豪能拥有整个米德加尔特
最好的朗姆酒。这是真的~

scripts.text:
[Tony]
Hey lady, I know this
joint is a dive, pretty much
on the verge of bein' totally
ghetto, but we're proud to
have the best rum in all of
Midgard. It's true~
scripts.translation:
[托尼]
嘿女士，我知道这地方很破，
简直快变成贫民窟了，但我们很
自豪能拥有整个米德加尔特
最好的朗姆酒。这是真的~

scripts.text:
[Tony]
Just a sip of this
beautiful drink and
you're on top of the
world! But it's best
for helpin' yah relax
and forget your worries.
scripts.translation:
[托尼]
只要抿上一口这美妙的饮品，
你就会感觉飘飘欲仙！不过它
最适合用来放松心情，忘掉烦恼。

scripts.text:
[Tony]
I don't take to bein'
a poet, but I do know
this. Our rum has the
sweet sweet flavor of
loneliness. You really
oughta try it when you can.
scripts.translation:
[托尼]
我不怎么喜欢当诗人，但我知道
这一点。我们的朗姆酒带着一种
名为孤独的甜美滋味。有机会你
真的应该尝尝看。

scripts.text:
[Garry]
Hey! Hey you...!
D'you wanna, you
wanna hear me tell
you a joke?! It goes...
Um, it goes like this...
scripts.translation:
[加里]
嘿！嘿，你……！
你想不想，你想不想听我
讲个笑话？！它是这么说的……
嗯，是这样的……

scripts.text:
[Garry]
Hey riddle middle,
the cat and th--
No! No, damn it!
That's a song!
No, wait, that's
not a song either...
scripts.translation:
[加里]
嘿，谜语中间，那只猫和——
不！不，该死！
那是首歌！不对，等等，那
也不是歌……

scripts.text:
[Bonse]
*Hiccup* I loooove
this rum! I caught a cold
once and one glass made
it go away! 'Course, I slept
for a week too, but that don't
matter! Pshaw! Science...
scripts.translation:
[邦塞]
*嗝* 我超——爱
这种朗姆酒！我有次感冒了，
喝了一杯就好了！当然，我也
睡了一周，但这没关系！呸！
科学什么的……

scripts.text:
[Bonse]
Oh, the flavor is just
so clean, but it's also
got a bit of a kick. I don't
know how to describe it.
Its the taste of happiness?
I'm too drunk to even tell!
scripts.translation:
[邦塞]
噢，这味道真的很清爽，但又
带点劲儿。我不知道该怎么形容。
是幸福的味道吗？我醉得连
这都分不清了！

scripts.text:
[Assam]
This place is nice
and usually pretty quiet.
I like to come here after
work, have a drink and just
chat with the bartender.
scripts.translation:
[阿萨姆]
这地方很不错，通常也很安静。
我喜欢下班后来这里，喝上一杯，
然后和酒保聊聊天。

scripts.text:
[Assam]
The rum here is incredibly
good too. It might even be
the best in the world. I dunno
why, but for some reason, its
taste reminds me of teamwork~
scripts.translation:
[阿萨姆]
这里的朗姆酒也非常好喝。
甚至可能是世界上最好的。我
不知道为什么，但出于某种原因，
它的味道让我想起了团队协作~

scripts.text:
[Lanko]
Oh, I'm only here
working as a waitress
to help out my father.
This job is so tiring, but
it's nice to see people so
relaxed and having a good time.
scripts.translation:
[兰科]
噢，我在这里当服务生只是
为了帮我父亲的忙。
这份工作很累，但看到大家如此
放松并享受时光，感觉很不错。

scripts.text:
[Lanko]
When I get some time
off, I'm going to explore
Lighthalzen and see all that
there is to see. But for now,
it doesn't look like we've got
any real shortage of drunks...
scripts.translation:
[兰科]
等我有空的时候，我要去探索
里希塔乐镇，看看那里所有的风景。
不过目前看来，我们似乎并不
缺醉汉……

scripts.text:
[Enku]
*Sob* I just got
dumped! Yeah, I thought
we were gonna get married,
but obviously I was wrong!
Damn it Sheryline! I loved you!
scripts.translation:
[恩库]
*呜咽* 我刚被甩了！是啊，我
还以为我们要结婚了，但显而易见
我错了！该死的谢莉琳！我爱过你！

scripts.text:
[Enku]
I usually don't care for
drinking, especially stuff
like gin or rum, but today,
this stuff tastes just like
my misery. This is all the
comfort I need, you hear?!
scripts.translation:
[恩库]
我平时不太喜欢喝酒，尤其是
像金酒或朗姆酒之类的，但今天，
这东西喝起来简直就像我的痛苦。
这就是我需要的全部慰藉，听到了吗？！

scripts.text:
[Linus]
After ten years
of marriage. My
wife divorced me...
scripts.translation:
[莱纳斯]
结婚十年后。我的妻子
跟我离婚了……

scripts.text:
[Linus]
So I guess there's no
place for me but here for
now. I don't know what it is,
but the rum is really good
today. Like, it's the flavor
of relaxing, joyous relief~
scripts.translation:
[莱纳斯]
所以我想目前除了这里，我
已经无处可去了。我不知道是怎么
回事，但今天的朗姆酒真的很好喝。
就像是，一种放松且喜悦的解脱感~

scripts.text:
[Mitchell]
You know, everyone
is different, but I think
humans are similar enough
that we can all meaningfully
connect on some level, right?
scripts.translation:
[米切尔]
你知道吗，每个人
都是不同的，但我认为
人类之间有着足够的相似性
让我们能在某种程度上
产生深刻的共鸣，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Mitchell]
Sure, a rich person might
have different problems than
a poor person, but the point
is, they've both got problems!
Pain, pleasure, sadness, joy.
Those link us all together.
scripts.translation:
[米切尔]
当然，富人面临的问题
可能与穷人不同，但重点
在于，他们都有各自的问题！
痛苦、欢愉、悲伤、喜悦。
这些情感将我们所有人联系在一起。

scripts.text:
[Mitchell]
So try not to be picky
about who's your pal and
who's not. We all need
somebody to be with, right?
scripts.translation:
[米切尔]
所以别太挑剔谁是你的
伙伴，谁不是。我们都需要
有人陪伴，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Dique]
One of the things I look
forward to during my day
is the drink I enjoy right
after work. It's the most
relaxing thing in the world.
scripts.translation:
[迪克]
我每天最期待的事情之一
就是下班后
享受的那杯美酒。那是世界上
最放松的事情了。

scripts.text:
[Dique]
Of course, there's
more to life than just
hanging out in pubs and
bars. The thing is, in my
case, pubs and bars are
all I happen to need~
scripts.translation:
[迪克]
当然，生活不仅仅是
在酒馆和酒吧里闲逛。
问题在于，就我而言，
酒馆和酒吧就是我所需要的全部~

scripts.text:
[Loudmouth]
Do you know who I am?!
Just look at this peg leg.
I was in the Comodo War,
Ski Troop division! I lost my
leg to earn your freedom!
scripts.translation:
[大嘴巴]
你知道我是谁吗？！
看看这只假腿。我曾参加过
克魔岛战争，是滑雪部队的！
为了换取你们的自由，我丢了这条腿！

scripts.text:
[Loudmouth]
H-hey! What's that
look for? What, you
don't believe me?!
scripts.translation:
[大嘴巴]
喂！你那是什么
眼神？怎么，你
不相信我吗？！

scripts.text:
[Guard]
This is a
restricted area.
Please keep clear
if you do not have
special authorization.
Thank you for your cooperating.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
这里是
禁区。如果您没有
特别授权，请绕行。
感谢您的配合。

scripts.text:
[Lasoei]
Oh phooey.
The same customers
are always coming in,
day after day. Can it
get any less exciting?
scripts.translation:
[拉索埃]
噢，真没劲。
每天都是那批老顾客
进进出出。还能比这更
无聊一点吗？

scripts.text:
[Lasoei]
Oh...!
W-welcome~
C-can I help you
with anything?
scripts.translation:
[拉索埃]
噢...！
欢、欢迎光临~
有、有什么我可以
帮您的吗？

scripts.text:
[Geonuii]
Greetings. This path
leads to the Library and
the Laboratory. Please be
aware that these places
are restricted from access
by the general public.
scripts.translation:
[格奴伊]
您好。这条路通往
图书馆和实验室。请注意，
这些地方禁止公众进入。

scripts.text:
[Bonnie]
Oh no...
Where did I put it?
scripts.translation:
[邦妮]
噢不...
我把它放哪儿了？

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
^3355FF(Whoa, it's a member
of the staff!)^000000 Good day!
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔卫兵]
^3355FF(哇，是工作人员！)^000000 您好！

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
This is a restricted
area! Please show
some ID immediately!
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔卫兵]
这里是禁区！
请立即出示您的身份证件！

scripts.text: ID?
scripts.translation: 身份证件？

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
I don't know how you
adventurers do things in
Rune-Midgarts, but over here
we have laws about trespassing!
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔卫兵]
我不知道你们冒险者在
卢恩·米德加兹是怎么做的，
但在我们这里，擅闯禁地可是违法的！

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
Unless you have special
authorization, nobody is
allowed into the Underground
Laboratory for security reasons.
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔卫兵]
除非您拥有特别授权，
否则出于安全考虑，任何人
都不允许进入地下实验室。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
Keep your eyes open.
I've heard rumors that some
adventurers from Rune-Midgarts
are trying to sneak into here!
I know the security here is
pretty much fail sure, but...
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔卫兵]
保持警惕。我听说有些
来自卢恩·米德加兹的冒险者
正试图潜入这里！我知道这里的
安保万无一失，但是...

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
This area is restricted
to the public! Who are you
and how did you get in here?!
Hey, I need backup right away!
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔卫兵]
此区域禁止公众进入！
你是谁，怎么进来的？！
喂，我需要立刻支援！

scripts.text:
[Repairman]
No wonder these things
break all the time! These
machines have been totally
abused! Ugh, there's no
appreciation for all of this
convenient technology...
scripts.translation:
[修理工]
难怪这些东西总是在坏！
这些机器完全被虐待了！
唉，根本没人懂得珍惜
这些便利的技术...

scripts.text:
[Repairman]
Yeah, all of this lab
equipment is really sensitive,
not to mention expensive. If
you ever handle this stuff, you
need to be extra cautious.
scripts.translation:
[修理工]
是啊，实验室里的这些设备
都非常精密，更不用说价格昂贵了。
如果你要接触这些东西，
必须格外小心。

scripts.text:
[Repairman]
Hey, you don't work--
G-guards! Hurry! There's
somebody over here!
scripts.translation:
[修理工]
喂，你不是工--
卫、卫兵！快来！
这儿有人！

scripts.text:
[Scientist]
Alright. Pull one test
tube out of the machine,
replace the other test
tube over here and then
clean the first test tube?
scripts.translation:
[科学家]
好吧。从机器里取出
一支试管，换上这边的
另一支试管，然后再
清洗第一支试管？

scripts.text:
[Scientist]
Or do I clean the test tube,
put it into the machine and
then replace the other one?
I'm so confused with this
procedure! If only I didn't
lose the instructions...
scripts.translation:
[科学家]
还是说我应该先清洗试管，
把它放入机器，然后再
更换另一支？
这套流程把我搞糊涂了！
要是没把说明书弄丢就好了...

scripts.text:
[Scientist]
Alright. Pull one test
tube out of the machine,
replace th--hey. You're
not Ralphie. Wait. Guaaards!
Help me, there's some weirdo!
scripts.translation:
[科学家]
好吧。从机器里取出
一支试管，更换这--嘿。你
不是拉尔菲。等等。卫、卫兵！
救命，这儿有个怪人！

scripts.text:
[Scientist]
Whoa whoa~!
Please! Don't
touch anything!
I'm dealing with highly
volatile chemicals here!
scripts.translation:
[科学家]
喔喔喔~！
请停下！千万别
碰任何东西！
我正在处理极易挥发的
化学物质！

scripts.text:
[Scientist]
Guards! Hurry,
there's someone
here, and I think
it's one of those crazy
stalkers! Why, why me?!
scripts.translation:
[科学家]
卫兵！快来，
这儿有人，
我觉得他是个疯狂的
跟踪狂！为什么，为什么是我？！

scripts.text: Nice day, huh?
scripts.translation: 天气不错，对吧？

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
...
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔卫兵]
...

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
...
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔卫兵]
...

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
...!
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔卫兵]
...!

scripts.text:
[Regenschirm Guard]
Do you wish to
go underground?
scripts.translation:
[雷根席尔姆卫兵]
你想进入
地下吗？

scripts.text:
[Regenschirm Guard]
May I help you?
If you would like to
enter, you must first
have a Laboratory Permit.
Thank you for your cooperation.
scripts.translation:
[雷根席尔姆卫兵]
有什么可以帮您的吗？
如果您想进入，必须先
持有研究所进出卡片。
感谢您的配合。

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Regenschirm Guard]
Thank you and
have a nice day.
scripts.translation:
[雷根席尔姆卫兵]
谢谢，
祝您生活愉快。

scripts.text:
[Regenschirm Guard]
Thank you and
have a nice day.
scripts.translation:
[雷根席尔姆卫兵]
谢谢，
祝您生活愉快。

scripts.text:
[Arthur]
The chairs here are
so not ergonomic. And
they're uncomfortable too!
But it's sooo cool inside this
bank and I just wanted to get
get away from all this heat...
scripts.translation:
[亚瑟]
这里的椅子
一点都不符合人体工学。
而且坐着也不舒服！
但银行里面真的好凉快，
我只是想躲避一下这酷热...

scripts.text:
[Helen]
You know, maybe when
I grow up, I'll be a bank
clerk. That sounds like a
really nice job, don't you
think? It's laid back and posh...
scripts.translation:
[海伦]
你知道吗，也许等我
长大后，会成为一名银行职员。
那听起来是一份很棒的工作，
你不觉得吗？既悠闲又高级...

scripts.text:
[Tadem]
I do so enjoy the
architectural structure
of this bank. It's quite
artistic with both classical
and modern elements. Would
you not agree? Fascinating...
scripts.translation:
[塔德姆]
我非常欣赏这家银行的
建筑结构。它融合了古典与
现代元素，非常有艺术感。
你不觉得吗？真是迷人...

scripts.text:
[Gracie]
Oh, it's so comfortable
in here~ Though, why are
we inside the bank when
the bank services aren't even
working? Yes, we're standing,
but we're doing it in comfort.
scripts.translation:
[格蕾西]
噢，这里面真舒服~ 
不过，既然银行的服务
都停止运作了，我们为什么
还要待在银行里呢？没错，
我们虽然站着，但站得很舒服。

scripts.text:
[Gracie]
In fact, it's so
comfortable here,
I think I'll refuse to leave.
Though, I'm willing to change
my mind if you can find a place
that's even more comfortable.
scripts.translation:
[格蕾西]
事实上，这里实在太舒服了，
我想我拒绝离开。 
不过，如果你能找到一个
比这里更舒服的地方，
我也愿意改变主意。

scripts.text:
[Bank Clerk]
Due to some critical system
errors, all of the bank services
have been temporarily stopped.
We apologize for any inconvenience and appreciate your understanding.
scripts.translation:
[银行职员]
由于出现了一些严重的系统错误，
所有的银行服务已暂时停止。
由此给您带来的不便，我们深表歉意，
并感谢您的理解。

scripts.text:
[Togii]
Oooh yeah...
Goes down smooth.
Morocc whiskey's the best!
^333333*Hiccup*^000000 Whoa, this stuff
really works fast! Heh heh~
scripts.translation:
[托吉]
噢耶...
真顺口。
莫洛克威士忌是最棒的！
^333333*嗝*^000000 哇，这玩意儿
劲儿真大！嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[Healthy Looking Guy]
Grrrrrr! Leave me alone!
How many times do I have
to keep telling you? I've never
hoarded item upgrade materials!
I swear that I'm innocent!
scripts.translation:
[看起来很健康的家伙]
唔唔唔唔！离我远点！
我到底要跟你说
多少遍？我从来没
囤积过强化道具！
我发誓我是清白的！

scripts.text:
[Hinkley]
Meh heh heh...
^333333*Hiccup*^000000 Believe
it or notsh, I'm...
walkin on a... Air...
Nevah thought I could
b-be sho freee-eeee-eee~
scripts.translation:
[欣克利]
嘿嘿嘿...
^333333*嗝*^000000 信不信由你，我...
在空气上...漫步...
从没想过我能
这——么——自——由——

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis guy
is completely
hammered out
of his mind!^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这家伙
完全喝得
神志不清了！^000000

scripts.text:
[Millette]
Let me go!
Let me GO!!
LET ME GO!!!
I didn't do nuthin'
wrong! I'm innocent!
^333333*Hic-Hic-Hiccup...*^000000
scripts.translation:
[米莱特]
放开我！
放开我！！
放开我！！！
我没做错
任何事！我是清白的！
^333333*嗝——嗝——嗝...*^000000

scripts.text:
[Millette]
What's wrong with
drinking and singing
in the street, huh?
Is it a crime to have
a beautiful tenor voice?!
Get me outta this joint!
scripts.translation:
[米莱特]
在街上喝酒唱歌
有什么不对吗，哈？
拥有美妙的高音
难道也是犯罪吗？！
快把我从这鬼地方带走！

scripts.text:
[Officer Guo]
Tell me...!
TELL ME...!!
Admit you did it!!
scripts.translation:
[郭警官]
告诉我...！
快告诉我...！！
承认你干的！！

scripts.text:
[Suspect]
Damn it!
I keep telling
you I'm not guilty!
scripts.translation:
[嫌疑人]
该死！
我一直跟你说
我是无辜的！

scripts.text:
[Officer Guo]
^333333*Sigh...*^000000

[Suspect]
You're wasting your
time. Just let me go.
scripts.translation:
[嫌疑人]
你在浪费
时间。放我走吧。

scripts.text:
[Officer Guo]
So...
How's your mother?
scripts.translation:
[郭警官]
那么...
你母亲最近怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Suspect]
That's none of
your business!
She's fine, I guess.
scripts.translation:
[嫌疑人]
那不关
你的事！
我想她还好。

scripts.text:
[Officer Guo]
When was the last
time you've seen her?
scripts.translation:
[郭警官]
你最后一次
见到她是什么时候？

scripts.text:
[Suspect]
I just told you,
that's none of
your business...!
scripts.translation:
[嫌疑人]
我刚说了，
那不关
你的事...！

scripts.text:
[Officer Guo]
You know, mothers
throughout the animal
kingdom instinctively
care for their young.
Humans are no exception.
Yours must be worried to death.
scripts.translation:
[郭警官]
你知道吗，动物界的
母亲们都会出于本能
照顾自己的幼崽。
人类也不例外。
你母亲一定担心死了。

scripts.text:
[Suspect]
...
Man...
You're starting
to weird me out.
scripts.translation:
[嫌疑人]
...
喂...
你开始
让我觉得毛骨悚然了。

scripts.text:
[Officer Guo]
Funny thing about humans,
though. It seems to be their
nature to lie, even when they
know they'll be caught. But
like all animals, they
instinctively fear pain...
scripts.translation:
[郭警官]
不过人类有个有趣的特点。
撒谎似乎是他们的天性，即使
他们知道会被抓到。但就像所有
动物一样，他们会本能地
畏惧痛苦...

scripts.text:
[Suspect]
N-no, no...
You gotta be...
You're bluffing.
Right?
scripts.translation:
[嫌疑人]
不，不...
你一定是...
你在虚张声势。
对吧？

scripts.text:
[Officer Guo]
NO.
You're bluffing.
Tell me...!
TELL ME...!!
Admit you did it!!
scripts.translation:
[郭警官]
不。
你在虚张声势。
告诉我...！
快告诉我...！！
承认你干的！！

scripts.text:
[Banquet Staff]
This Banquet Hall is used
to hold events such as dinner
parties with partners, clients
and other associates, and press
conferences. Of course, there's
nothing going on right now.
scripts.translation:
[宴会工作人员]
这座宴会厅用于举办各种活动，
例如与合作伙伴、客户及其他
关联人士的晚宴，以及新闻发布会。
当然，现在这里什么活动也没有。

scripts.text:
[Banquet Staff]
Sometimes peace and quiet
is a welcome change of pace,
but right now I'm feeling quite
bored. I think I would rather
be busy than twiddling my
thumbs, to tell the truth.
scripts.translation:
[宴会工作人员]
偶尔的清静也是一种不错的改变，
但说实话，我现在觉得相当无聊。
我宁愿忙个不停，也不想在这里无所事事。

scripts.text:
[Luccet]
Shhhh! Hey, my brother's
''it,'' so I gotta find a place
to hide! Wait, would you just
stand really still? I could
just hide behind you! No?
Nuts! Olly olly oxen free!
scripts.translation:
[卢塞特]
嘘！喂，我哥哥在玩“捉迷藏”，
我得找个地方躲起来！等等，你能不能
站稳一点？我可以直接躲在你身后！
不行吗？真倒霉！捉迷藏结束啦！

scripts.text:
[Hanccet]
Man... I hate being ''it!''
I'm horrible at this game!
Alright, okay, if I were my
sister Luccet, where would
I think I would not look for
me? Of course...! The sewers!
scripts.translation:
[汉塞特]
唉……我最讨厌玩“捉迷藏”了！
我玩这个游戏简直是个灾难！
好吧，好吧，如果我是我妹妹卢塞特，
我会觉得在哪里最不可能找到我呢？
当然是……下水道！

scripts.text:
[Annette]
I've heard that the
Rekenber Banquet Hall
is also used to hold weddings.
That must be so wonderful~
scripts.translation:
[安妮特]
我听说雷肯贝尔宴会厅
也会举办婚礼。
那一定非常美好吧~

scripts.text:
[Annette]
Even if it is more expensive,
I'd want to have my wedding
here. Marriage is only once
in a lifetime, ideally, so I'd
want to make mine the most
memorable experience.
scripts.translation:
[安妮特]
即使费用更高，我也想在这里
举办婚礼。理想情况下，婚姻一生只有一次，
所以我想让我的婚礼成为最难忘的回忆。

scripts.text:
^3355FF*Shhhhhhzzzz*
*Shhhhhhzzzz*^000000

[Mereth]
Shhhhh....
Aaaaaaaahhh...
scripts.translation:
[梅雷斯]
嘶嘶……
啊啊啊啊啊……

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe employee turned his
head and peered into your
eyes through the black mask
on his face. Mereth stared
wordlessly for a moment and
then began to dance a lively,
creepily jovial jig.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF职员转过头，透过脸上的黑色面具
盯着你的眼睛。梅雷斯沉默地注视了一会儿，
然后开始跳起一段欢快而又诡异的舞步。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis is simply a pile
of files, a smattering of
books and a family portrait.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这只是一堆文件、几本书
和一张全家福。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis desk is very
neat and well organized
in comparison to the other
desks you've seen in your
time. You take a moment to
fully marvel at its tidiness.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF与你见过的其他办公桌相比，
这张办公桌非常整洁有序。
你停下来，对它的整洁程度感到惊叹。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis desk has a bookshelf
that is crammed with all sorts
of books. Out of curiosity, you
decide to pick one out.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这张办公桌有一个书架，
上面塞满了各种各样的书。
出于好奇，你决定挑出一本来看看。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFHowever, the book you
happen to touch contains
an amazing amount of dark
power, causing you to drop it.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF然而，你碰巧拿到的那本书
蕴含着惊人的黑暗力量，让你惊得脱手掉落。^000000

scripts.text:
[Noama]
Hee hee~!
You wanna hear
something funny?
I heard there's a bar in
Prontera where this guy
sneaks singles into Jawa--
scripts.translation:
[诺阿玛]
嘻嘻~！
想听点有趣的事吗？
我听说在普隆德拉有一家酒吧，
有个家伙偷偷把单身人士带进贾瓦——

scripts.text:
[Mazwon]
Noama...!
These machines are
acting up again! Get
over here right now!
scripts.translation:
[马兹翁]
诺阿玛……！
这些机器又出故障了！
立刻给我过来！

scripts.text:
[Noama]
What?!
Stop bugging me,
I didn't do anything!
scripts.translation:
[诺阿玛]
什么？！
别烦我，我什么都没做！

scripts.text:
[Mazwon]
Crap. Crap! Crap
crap crap crap crap!
These desk machines aren't
supposed to work like this!
scripts.translation:
[马兹翁]
该死。该死！该死
该死该死该死该死！
这些办公机器不应该是这种运行方式的！

scripts.text:
[Mazwon]
Noama...!
These machines are
acting up again! Get
over here right now!
scripts.translation:
[马兹翁]
诺阿玛……！
这些机器又出故障了！
立刻给我过来！

scripts.text:
[Noama]
What?!
Stop bugging me,
I didn't do anything!
scripts.translation:
[诺阿玛]
什么？！
别烦我，我什么都没做！

scripts.text:
[Mareth]
Yoo hoo hoo~
Oh, how I love
love love chocolate!
scripts.translation:
[马雷斯]
哟吼吼~
噢，我真的好爱
爱爱爱巧克力！

scripts.text:
[Mareth]
Eat it up...
Or just melt it.
Slather it all over me.
Booyah. New life aspiration.
scripts.translation:
[马雷斯]
把它吃掉……
或者直接融化它。
把它涂满我全身。
耶！这是我的人生新目标。

scripts.text:
[Eiya]
Jorje seems so cranky
recently. He's usually
more laid back than this.
Oh well, I hope that he
feels better.
scripts.translation:
[英也]
约尔赫最近看起来情绪很差。
他平时比这要随和得多。
唉，希望他能好起来吧。

scripts.text:
[Eiya]
Ooh, would you like
to look at my miniature
doll collection? I love
collecting cute dolls!
scripts.translation:
[英也]
噢，你想看看我的微型
玩偶收藏吗？我最喜欢收集可爱的玩偶了！

scripts.text:

filled with scribbling. You
can only read some of the
messages that have been
quickly scrawled on it.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你发现了一块
写满涂鸦的黑板。
你只能辨认出上面
潦草写下的部分
信息.^000000

- Jorje
scripts.translation:

完成所有事项。''

scripts.text:
[Rocky]
Woof woof!
scripts.translation:
[洛基]
汪汪！

scripts.text:
[Rocky]
Grrrrrrr...
scripts.translation:
[洛基]
呜呜呜呜...

scripts.text:
[Jay]
My mommy and daddy
always come home late.
So I eat dinner alone.
All by myself. Everyday.
scripts.translation:
[杰伊]
爸爸妈妈总是
很晚才回家。
所以我总是一个人
吃晚饭。每天都是
这样。

scripts.text:
[Jay]
Food doesn't taste as
good when you're not
eating with anybody.
Maybe I'm just lonely.
scripts.translation:
[杰伊]
一个人吃饭的时候，
食物好像没那么好吃了。
也许只是因为我太寂寞了。

scripts.text:
[Housemaid Jane]
This house is enormous...
It's clearly much too big
for a regularly sized family.
And it takes me forever to
make sure that it stays clean!
scripts.translation:
[女仆 简]
这房子大得惊人...
对于一个普通的家庭来说，
这显然太大了。
我得花好长时间才能
把它打扫干净！

scripts.text:
[Housemaid Jane]
It's not easy keeping
things neat and tidy when
you're responsible for acres
of indoor living space. Being
a maid can be pretty hard...
scripts.translation:
[女仆 简]
当你负责打理大片面积的
室内生活空间时，要保持
整洁可真不容易。当个
女仆还挺辛苦的...

scripts.text:
[Housemaid Brenda]
I better dust extra
gently around this vase.
It's worth ten million zeny
and if it were to-- No. No!
I'm not even going to think it!
scripts.translation:
[女仆 布伦达]
我在擦这个花瓶的时候
得格外小心。它值一千万
泽尼，要是万一——不，不！
我连想都不敢想！

scripts.text:
[Benatuth]
Down there, the repairman
is just finishing maintenance
on our chairman's private
Airship. Can you imagine
having one of those of your
very own to fly around in?
scripts.translation:
[贝纳图斯]
下面那边，维修工正准备
完成我们董事长私人
飞空艇的维护工作。你能想象
拥有一架属于自己的
飞空艇到处飞吗？

scripts.text:
[Benatuth]
Yeah, the chairman of
the Rekenber Corporation...
He's a really powerful person.
It's almost scary what he can
do with his money, you know?
scripts.translation:
[贝纳图斯]
没错，就是雷肯贝尔
集团的董事长... 他可是个
非常有权势的人物。他能用
金钱做到的事情，简直
让人感到可怕，你懂吗？

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard Drew]
Dude, check it out~
Official glossy photos
of the Kafra Ladies. Now...
With 20% more garter belts!
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔卫兵 德鲁]
伙计，快看这个~
卡普拉女士们的官方
精美照片。现在... 
吊袜带还增加了20%！

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard Tan]
So they're all wearing
garter belts in these?
Whoa, that means they
even got the glasses chick
to wear 'em too? That's the
best news I've heard all day!
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔卫兵 谭]
所以她们在这些照片里
都穿着吊袜带吗？
哇，那意味着连那个戴眼镜的
妹子也穿了吗？这真是我
今天听到的最好的消息！

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard Drew]
Okay man, you know these
are limited edition collector's
items, so each one is worth
300,000 zeny. I mean, I have
an extra set, but I don't know
if you'd wanna buy them off--
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔卫兵 德鲁]
好啦伙计，你知道这些是
限量版收藏品，所以每张都
值300,000 泽尼。我是说，我
正好有一套多余的，不知道
你有没有兴趣买下——

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard Tan]
I'll take them all.
Wait, all of them except
for that young kid. Just the
idea of having her glamour
photo around strikes me as...
Yeah. Yeah, it's no good.
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔卫兵 谭]
我全都要。
等等，除了那个小姑娘的
以外，其他的都要。光是想到
把她的写真放在身边，就让我觉得... 
没错，这不太好。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard Tan]
Whoa, whoa. Now this...
This is art. The lighting,
the angle, the... the...
subject matter. Oh yes.
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔卫兵 谭]
哇，哇。这才是...
这才是艺术。这光影，
这角度，这... 这... 
主题。噢，没错。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard Drew]
Man, these officially licensed
Kafra Lady glossies... They're
worth every zeny we paid. Say
goodbye Swimsuit Calendar,
and hellooooo Kafra Leilah~
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔卫兵 德鲁]
伙计，这些官方授权的
卡普拉女士精美照片... 
每一分泽尼都花得值。跟
泳装年历说再见吧，
卡普拉 莱拉万岁~

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard Tan]
Leilah? Oh, you mean
the glasses chick? Dude...
Dude. She's my favorite too!
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔卫兵 谭]
莱拉？噢，你是说
那个戴眼镜的妹子吗？伙计...
伙计。她也是我的最爱！

scripts.text:
[Delna]
Sometimes the simple
pleasures can give you
the most happiness. For me,
going outside and basking in
the sun is the greatest thing~
scripts.translation:
[黛尔娜]
有时候，简单的
乐趣能给你带来
最大的幸福。对我来说，
去户外沐浴在
阳光下就是最棒的事~

scripts.text:
[Delna]
Yes, sunbathing in a quiet
and relaxing place can be
so refreshing. And if you're
careful about not getting a
sunburn or a tan, a little sun
can be really good for you.
scripts.translation:
[黛尔娜]
是的，在安静
放松的地方晒太阳
真的很舒畅。只要
注意不要晒伤或晒黑，
适度的阳光对身体
非常有好处。

scripts.text:
[Martial Artist]
Curses...
I've come to the
wrong place to seek
out a challenge. No
one here is really all
that mighty or competitive!
scripts.translation:
[武术家]
该死...
我来错地方寻找
挑战了。这里根本
没有一个真正强大
或好胜的人！

scripts.text:
[Martial Artist]
This whole city thinks
it can buy power and safety
with money. They don't know
the value of a nice, friendly
brawl. Hopefully, I'll find a
rival around here soon...
scripts.translation:
[武术家]
这整座城市都以为
可以用金钱买到力量和安全。
他们根本不懂一场痛快、
友好的格斗有多么有价值。
希望我能尽快在这里
找到对手...

scripts.text:
[Kosit]
This city might have
more guards and rules
than other places, but
I still don't know if it's
really safe to live here.
scripts.translation:
[科西特]
这座城市虽然比其他地方
有更多的卫兵和规矩，
但我还是不知道
住在这里是否真的安全。

scripts.text:
[Kosit]
I mean, the reason we have
these rules is because of all
the unruly gangsters that can
sometimes get into the city.
I mean, it's relatively peaceful and all. But these rules...
scripts.translation:
[科西特]
我是说，我们之所以
有这些规矩，是因为总有
那些无法无天的歹徒
会潜入这座城市。
虽然这里相对和平，
但这些规矩...

scripts.text:
[Kosit]
It's good to be safe,
but I don't know if it's
a good idea to sacrifice
our freedoms or standard
of living, you know?
scripts.translation:
[科西特]
安全固然是好事，
但我不知道牺牲我们的
自由或生活水准来换取安全
是否是个好主意，你懂吗？

scripts.text:
[Sopheap]
Oh, you youngsters.
Always traveling around
and having adventures and
fighting monsters. I certainly
had my fill of excitement back
when I was your age, long ago.
scripts.translation:
[索菲普]
噢，你们这些年轻人。
总是四处旅行、冒险
并与怪物战斗。很久以前
我年轻的时候，也确实
经历过足够多的刺激了。

scripts.text:
[Sopheap]
Sure, I miss doing all
of that, but now I'm content
with just relaxing and resting.
Still, there are a lot of old folk who refuse to sit still like this~
scripts.translation:
[索菲普]
当然，我也很怀念
做那些事的感觉，但现在
我只想安稳地放松休息。
不过，还是有很多老人
不愿像这样坐以待毙呢~

scripts.text:
[Gopal]
Granny may be happy
just sitting around and
enjoying the peaceful life,
but I'm not! I'm too young
to just lay down and let
these days just pass by!
scripts.translation:
[戈帕尔]
老奶奶可能觉得
只是坐着享受平静的生活
就很幸福，但我可不！
我还太年轻，不能就这样
虚度光阴！

scripts.text:
[Gopal]
I wanna make something
of myself. Maybe someday,
I'll found a company as big
as the Rekenber Corporation!
scripts.translation:
[戈帕尔]
我想成就一番事业。
也许有一天，我会创办一家
像雷肯贝尔公司那样大的企业！

scripts.text:
[Kimmy]
Unlike most places,
Lighthalzen has many
beautiful clothing and
accessory shops. This
place is heaven to a
trend-setter like me~!
scripts.translation:
[金米]
与其他地方不同，
里希塔乐镇有很多
漂亮的服装和饰品店。
对于像我这样的潮流引领者
来说，这里简直是天堂~!

scripts.text:
[Kimmy]
I don't know if you
adventurers are interested
in fashion, but you can trash
your old clothes and get some
new, unique and trendy gear
over here in Lighthalzen~
scripts.translation:
[金米]
我不知道你们这些
冒险者是否对时尚感兴趣，
但你可以扔掉旧衣服，
来里希塔乐镇换上一些
全新、独特且时髦的装备~

scripts.text:
[Bodger]
Another hungry day...
I don't have any money
and even if I did, there's
no place that sells food
I'd actually eat. Oh, man.
I'm barely living as it is.
scripts.translation:
[博杰]
又是挨饿的一天...
我没钱，就算有钱，
也没有什么地方卖的食物
是我愿意吃的。噢，天哪。
我现在简直是在勉强糊口。

scripts.text:
[Bodger]
I hear that the people
who live Uptown eat totally
delicious, gourmet food eight
times a day! Hopefully it's just an exaggeration. 'Cuz if it
wasn't, I'd be so mad...
scripts.translation:
[博杰]
我听说住在上城区的人
每天能吃八顿
超级美味的高级美食！
希望那只是夸张。如果不是的话，
我真的会气疯的...

scripts.text:
[Avetis]
A-ack...
^333333*Cough cough*^000000
Would you give me
some m-medicine?!
^333333*Cough cough haack*^000000
Sweet Christmas, it hurts...

[Avetis]
I sk-skipped work
because I've been too
sick t-to go. ^333333*Cough*^000000
But now I don't have
the money to ^333333*Haack*^000000
buy med-medicine...
scripts.translation:
[阿维蒂斯]
我翘了-工作，
因为我病得太重
没法去。 ^333333*咳*^000000
但现在我没钱
去买 ^333333*咳*^000000
药...

scripts.text:
[Diana]
Oh wow, that weapon
is fantastic! But I'm sure
that it must be really
expensive. Huh...
scripts.translation:
[黛安娜]
哇，那件武器
太棒了！但我敢肯定
它一定非常昂贵。
唔...

scripts.text:
[Shop Assistant]
Ma'am, are you talking
about this Stiletto? You
certainly have an eye for
quality weapons. If you
don't mind me asking,
where are you from?
scripts.translation:
[店员]
女士，您是在说
这把细剑吗？您对
优质武器的眼光真好。
如果不介意我问的话，
您是从哪里来的？

scripts.text:
[Diana]
Oh, I was born
and raised in Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[黛安娜]
噢，我是在莫洛克
出生并长大的。

scripts.text:
[Shop Assistant]
Ah yes, I've heard many
good things about that town.
You've certainly proven that
people from Morocc truly have
good taste. Now, this Stiletto
is a steal at 39,800 zeny...
scripts.translation:
[店员]
啊是的，我听过很多
关于那个小镇的好评。
你确实证明了
莫洛克的人真的很有
品味。现在，这把细剑
只要39,800 泽尼，简直太划算了……

scripts.text:
[Diana]
Huh...?!
That's ridiculous!
Never mind that, let
me take a look at that
Gladius in the corner.
scripts.translation:
[黛安娜]
哈……？！
太荒谬了！
先不说那个，让我
看看角落里的那把
格拉迪斯。

scripts.text:
[Shop Assistant]
The Gladius?
Ah, that would be
39,800 zeny, ma'am.
scripts.translation:
[店员]
格拉迪斯？
啊，那位女士，那要
39,800 泽尼。

scripts.text:
[Diana]
Oh, that's a really
good price. I'll take it!
scripts.translation:
[黛安娜]
噢，那价格真的很
不错。我要了！

scripts.text:
[Shop Assistant]
Yes, this replica really
does look just like an
actual Gladius, does it
not? Although not a true
weapon, it's quite capable of
opening the toughest envelopes.
scripts.translation:
[店员]
是的，这件复制品看起来
真的和真正的格拉迪斯
一模一样，不是吗？
虽然不是真正的武器，
但用来拆开最厚的信封
也是绰绰有余的。

scripts.text:
[Diana]
...
......
I take that back.
This shop really sucks.
scripts.translation:
[黛安娜]
...
......
我收回刚才的话。
这家店真烂。

scripts.text:
[Shop Assistant]
Welcome to our
store where we offer
many unique products that
you can't find anywhere else.
scripts.translation:
[店员]
欢迎光临本店，我们提供
许多在其他任何地方
都找不到的独特商品。

scripts.text:
[Shop Assistant]
However, shopping is only available to our members. There's an annual
membership fee that's waived when you spend a certain amount every
month in our store. If you invite your friends, you'll receive spe--
scripts.translation:
[店员]
不过，只有会员才能购物。我们设有年费制度，
如果您每月在店内的消费达到一定金额，
即可免除年费。如果您邀请朋友，您将获得特——

scripts.text:
[{0}]
N-no thank you!
I'm not interested!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不——不用了！
我没兴趣！

scripts.text:
[Sergei]
You know, there's an
interesting story about
the axe that's hanging
over there. Would you
like me to tell you?
scripts.translation:
[谢尔盖]
你知道吗，关于挂在
那边的斧头，有一个
很有趣的故事。需要我
讲给你听吗？

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 好的。

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Sergei]
This previous owner of
this Weapon Shop was
a convicted serial killer.
Each night, he'd take that
axe and cruelly murder
beautiful ladies like me.
scripts.translation:
[谢尔盖]
这家武器店的前任主人
是个被定罪的连环杀手。
每天晚上，他都会拿着那把
斧头，残忍地杀害像我这样
美丽的女士。

scripts.text:
[Sergei]
When he was finally
caught, they beheaded
him with his own axe.
Since then, they say that
his ghost still lingers and
sharpens this axe at night.
scripts.translation:
[谢尔盖]
当他最终被捕时，他们
用他自己的斧头砍下了
他的头颅。从那时起，
据说他的幽灵仍然徘徊于此，
并在深夜磨利这把斧头。

scripts.text:
[Sergei]
Just thinking about
it gives me goosebumps!
And I'm supposed to work
here! It's so creepy!
scripts.translation:
[谢尔盖]
光是想想都让我
起鸡皮疙瘩！
而我居然还要在这里工作！
太阴森了！

scripts.text:
[Sergei]
Oh, how disappointing~
It's the perfect story for
the season. Well, now that
I think about it, that story is
actually pretty creepy...
scripts.translation:
[谢尔盖]
噢，真令人失望~
这简直是应季的完美故事。
不过，现在仔细想想，
那个故事确实挺吓人的……

scripts.text:
[Srinivas]
Those rundown buildings
in the slums are an eyesore
that offend the entire city!
I just wish they would wreck
them down. What do I care
about the poor and needy?
scripts.translation:
[斯里尼瓦斯]
贫民窟里那些破旧的建筑
简直是碍眼的垃圾，侮辱了
整个城市！我真希望有人能把
它们全部拆掉。我才不在乎
那些穷苦需要帮助的人呢？

scripts.text:
[Victor Perfecto]
I've heard that the
Rekenber Corporation
actually created the
environment in Lighthalzen
through artificial means.
scripts.translation:
[维克多·佩尔费克托]
我听说雷肯贝尔公司
实际上是通过人工手段
创造了里希塔乐镇的
自然环境。

scripts.text:
[Victor Perfecto]
It seems like it'd take
a lot of investment, but
artificially creating an
environment isn't impossible
with the means available to
the Rekenber Corporation.
scripts.translation:
[维克多·佩尔费克托]
这似乎需要投入大量资金，
但凭借雷肯贝尔公司现有的
手段，人工创造环境
并非不可能。

scripts.text:
[Victor Perfecto]
^333333*Sigh...*^000000
Still, it's pretty
depressing to think
that the beauty of nature
can be man-made and
equated to zeny, you know?
scripts.translation:
[维克多·佩尔费克托]
^333333*唉……*^000000
即便如此，想到大自然的
美景竟然可以被人工制造
并与泽尼等价，
还是觉得挺令人沮丧的，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Vergil]
The weather is so
nice today, like always.
I just want to ditch work,
run outside and work out.
scripts.translation:
[维吉尔]
今天的天气一如既往地
好啊。我真想翘班，
直接跑到外面去锻炼一下。

scripts.text: Where do you want to go?
scripts.translation: 你想去哪里？

scripts.text: But shouldn't you go to work?
scripts.translation: 但你不该去工作吗？

scripts.text: Have you heard about the serial killer?
scripts.translation: 你听说过那个连环杀手吗？

scripts.text:
[Vergil]
Well, those guys in
black suits, not to mention
the ruffians that manage to
invade town, sometimes sort
of make it kind of unsafe to
go out all by yourself.
scripts.translation:
[维吉尔]
唉，那些穿黑西装的家伙，
更不用说那些居然能闯进
城镇的流氓了，有时候
一个人出门确实会觉得
不太安全。

scripts.text:
[Vergil]
But me and a buddy are
planning to head to the
Al De Baran Turbo Track
one of these days. Boy,
the last time we went,
he wasted a lot of zeny.
scripts.translation:
[维吉尔]
不过我和一个哥们儿
打算过些日子去一趟
艾尔帕兰涡轮赛道。
男孩，上次我们去的时候，
他浪费了好多泽尼。

scripts.text:
[Vergil]
He actually won some
kind of potion as a prize
and let me have it. I drank
it and it made me move really
slowly. Now what kind of prize
is that supposed to be?!
scripts.translation:
[维吉尔]
他居然中了某种药水的奖
然后把它给了我。我喝了之后
动作变得超级慢。这到底算
是什么奖品啊？！

scripts.text:
[Vergil]
I think my buddy
was totally scammed.
That, or I was totally
tricked by him to drink it.
How they came up with such a ridiculous idea for a prize!
scripts.translation:
[维吉尔]
我觉得我那哥们儿
完全被骗了。
要么就是他故意骗我
喝下去的。他们到底是怎么
想到这种荒唐的奖品的！

scripts.text:
[Vergil]
Wha--?! I didn't say
I was going to ditch work,
I just said I wanted to!
But just to spite you, maybe
just maybe, I won't go today!
scripts.translation:
[维吉尔]
什——？！我没说
我要翘班，我只是说
我想翘！但为了气你，
也许，只是也许，我今天
就不去了！

scripts.text:
[Vergil]
Then again, I don't
think I can slack on
this project. Curses...
The weekend certainly
doesn't come fast enough!
scripts.translation:
[维吉尔]
话又说回来，我觉得
我不能在这个项目上
偷懒。可恶……
周末怎么还不快点到来！

scripts.text:
[Vergil]
What, you mean that
axe murderer from a long
time ago? Well, I heard a
rumor that it actually wasn't
like that. Let's see, how
did the story go?
scripts.translation:
[维吉尔]
什么，你是说很久以前
那个斧头杀人魔吗？
我听传闻说事情其实
并不是那样的。让我想想，
故事是怎么说的来着？

scripts.text:
[Vergil]
I heard that some hat
maker, the one who makes
the Smokie Hat, accidentally
made a Person Headgear
instead of, like, a hat made
of monsters. Don't ask me how.
scripts.translation:
[维吉尔]
我听说有个帽子匠，
就是做狸猫帽子的那个，
他不小心做出了一个
人头头饰，而不是那种
用怪物做的帽子。别问我怎么做出来的。

scripts.text:
[Vergil]
Yeah, I think relatives
of that Airship Captain...
They were totally made into
a hat on accident. Supposedly,
it looks like a Reindeer Head,
but now that's just too weird.
scripts.translation:
[维吉尔]
对，我觉得是那位
飞空艇船长的亲戚……
他们不小心被做成了帽子。
据说看起来像是个驯鹿头，
但现在想起来也太奇怪了。

scripts.text:
[Jorje]
Arrrgh, I don't
have any time for
talking! I'm in the
middle of an important
task! H-hold on a second!
scripts.translation:
[约尔赫]
啊啊啊，我没时间
跟你闲聊！我正在
处理一件重要的任务！
等、等一下！

scripts.text:
[Jorje]
D-don't come any
closer! Anyone who
comes near me might
just screw me up! Back off!
scripts.translation:
[约尔赫]
别、别靠近我！
任何靠近我的人
都可能会搞砸我的事！
退后！

scripts.text:
[Jorje]
Oh man...
I've been working so
hard and haven't taken
any breaks. I think I'll
reward myself and buy
something like maybe--
scripts.translation:
[约尔赫]
噢天呐……
我一直这么努力工作，
连休息都没休息过。
我想奖励一下自己，
买点什么，比如——

scripts.text:
[Jorje]
No! No, I'm not
gonna buy anything!
I've got my future wife
to think about! Must...
Save... More... Money!
scripts.translation:
[约尔赫]
不！不，我什么都
不买！我还要为
未来的妻子考虑呢！必须……
攒……更多……钱！

scripts.text:
[Leimi]
Oh...!
Good heavens!
Um, may I help you?
scripts.translation:
[莱米]
噢……！
天哪！
那个，有什么我可以帮您的吗？

scripts.text:
[Leimi]
Oh, you're an Assassin!
Oh, you boys are soooo cute!
And so cool and so mysterious all at the same time! I love you!
scripts.translation:
[莱米]
噢，你是刺客！
噢，你们这些男孩真的好可爱！
而且又帅气又神秘！我好喜欢！

scripts.text:
[Leimi]
An Assassin...?
Oh, you wouldn't happen
to know any Assassin boys
that might be single, do you?
Oh-my-god, they're hunky-hot~
scripts.translation:
[莱米]
刺客……？
噢，你刚好认识什么
单身的刺客男孩吗？
我的天呐，他们一定很健壮火辣~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What the...?
That sound. Did...
Did someone just
take my picture?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
什么情况...?
刚才那个声音。
难道...有人在
偷拍我吗？

scripts.text:
[Saera]
Welcome to the
temporary headquarters
of Cool Event Corporation.
How may I help you today?
scripts.translation:
[赛拉]
欢迎来到
Cool Event公司的
临时总部。
请问有什么可以帮您？

scripts.text: Temporary headquarters?
scripts.translation: 临时总部？

scripts.text: Voting
scripts.translation: 投票

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Saera]
Our headquarters building
is currently undergoing
reconstruction, so we are
basing our operations in
this place for the meantime.
scripts.translation:
[赛拉]
我们的总部大楼
目前正在进行
重建，所以暂时
将业务设在
这个地方。

scripts.text:
[Saera]
Currently, Kafra Corporation
and Cool Event Corp are working
on a collaborative program that
will provide direct teleport
services to dungeons.
scripts.translation:
[赛拉]
目前，卡普拉公司
与Cool Event公司
正在合作开展一项
为地下城提供直接
传送服务的计划。

scripts.text:
[Saera]
Due to technical issues,
both companies cannot provide
teleport services to the same
dungeon. Therefore, we will be
selecting our valued customers to choose the company they want.
scripts.translation:
[赛拉]
由于技术问题，
两家公司无法同时
为同一个地下城
提供传送服务。因此，
我们将邀请尊贵的客户
来选择他们心仪的公司。

scripts.text:
[Saera]
Only a limited number of
voters will be chosen, so
you can check your voting
eligibility at the headquarters
of both participating companies. Thank you for your patronage~
scripts.translation:
[赛拉]
由于投票人数有限，
您可以前往参与合作的
两家公司的总部
确认您的投票资格。
感谢您的光临~

scripts.text:
[Saera]
Currently, Kafra Corporation
and Cool Event Corp are working
on a collaborative program that
will provide direct teleport
services to dungeons.
scripts.translation:
[赛拉]
目前，卡普拉公司
与Cool Event公司
正在合作开展一项
为地下城提供直接
传送服务的计划。

scripts.text:
[Saera]
Due to technical issues,
both companies cannot provide
teleport services to the same
dungeon. Therefore, we will be
selecting a number of valued customers to vote for their choice.
scripts.translation:
[赛拉]
由于技术问题，
两家公司无法同时
为同一个地下城
提供传送服务。因此，
我们将邀请部分尊贵的客户
进行投票选择。

scripts.text:
[Saera]
I've just reviewed your
information and would like
to inform you that you are
indeed eligible to vote.
Your participation in this
election is much appreciated.
scripts.translation:
[赛拉]
我刚刚核对了您的
信息，在此通知您，
您确实拥有投票资格。
非常感谢您参与本次
选举。

scripts.text:
[Saera]
Remember that the
election polls can be
found in either Prontera
or Juno. Thank you very much.
scripts.translation:
[赛拉]
请记住，选举投票点
设在普隆德拉或
朱诺。非常感谢。

scripts.text:
[Saera]
Thank you.
Have a good day.
scripts.translation:
[赛拉]
谢谢。
祝您生活愉快。

scripts.text:
[Jellarin]
I don't like this.
But I don't like that
idea either. What will
I do for a new event, eh?
scripts.translation:
[杰拉林]
我不喜欢这个。
但我也并不喜欢
那个主意。为了搞个新活动，
我该怎么办才好呢？

scripts.text:
[Jellarin]
I need something
major, something that'll
really shake up the world,
something epochal, but what?
Hey, do you have any ideas?
scripts.translation:
[杰拉林]
我需要一些
重大的东西，一些能
真正震撼世界的东西，
一些划时代的变革，但到底是什么？
嘿，你有什么主意吗？

scripts.text:
[Baoto]
Hmmm...
The employees seem
to be having too much
fun amongst themselves
recently. This does not
bode well at all...
scripts.translation:
[包托]
嗯... 
最近员工们似乎
玩得有点太开心了。
这可不是什么
好兆头...

scripts.text:
[Baoto]
It looks like I'm
just going to have to
start cracking that whip
more often and much
harder. Ha ha ha ha!
scripts.translation:
[包托]
看来我只能
更频繁、更严厉地
动用鞭子来管教他们了。
哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Cesuna]
Ack! I'm totally
swamped with all this
work! But I don't wanna
do any of it. That's it!
I totally need a break.
scripts.translation:
[塞苏娜]
啊！这些工作
简直要把我淹没了！
但我一点都不想做。
就是这样！
我真的需要休息一下。

scripts.text:
[Cesuna]
^333333*Sigh...*^000000
I wonder if Saera
would ever consider
going out with me?
That would be nice~
scripts.translation:
[塞苏娜]
^333333*唉...*^000000
不知道赛拉
会不会考虑
和我约会呢？
那一定很棒~

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Employee]
Greetings. As part of our
effort to relieve the poor,
Rekenber is providing job
opportunities targeted for
citizens of the slum areas.
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔员工]
您好。为了
减轻贫困人口的负担，
雷肯贝尔正为贫民窟的
居民提供就业机会。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Employee]
You can choose to work
from home, or undergo a
little bit of training for more
professional positions. This
is a great chance to make a
difference... and some money~
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔员工]
您可以选择居家办公，
或者接受一些培训以
从事更专业的职位。
这是一个改变命运... 
并赚点钱的好机会~

scripts.text:
[A Scientist]
What happened? All the machines are ruined and the research report are gone! The history of Regenschirm has been hacked!
scripts.translation:
[一位科学家]
发生了什么事？所有的机器都毁了，研究报告也不见了！雷根修芦的历史被黑客入侵了！

scripts.text:
[Scientist]
It takes so long for
this device to process
all the data and give me
the results. Still, the wait
heightens my anticipation...
scripts.translation:
[科学家]
这个设备处理完所有数据并
给出结果需要很长时间。
即便如此，等待的过程
也让我的期待感倍增……

scripts.text:
[Scientist]
What?! Guards!
Hurry, there's an
intruder right here!
scripts.translation:
[科学家]
什么？！卫兵！
快点，这里有入侵者！
